# ============================================================================
#  AXIS — Sonify guitar pedal family
#  JUCE 9 · VST3 / CLAP / Standalone · WebView UI
#
#  Project root : C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN axis   <- this file lives here
#  Sources      : C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN axis\src
#  JUCE 9       : C:\workspace\JUCE
#
#  The root path contains spaces, so keep every path quoted:
#     cd "C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN axis"
#     cmake -B build -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64
#     cmake --build build --config Release
#
#  Everything is written inside .\build — nothing is copied anywhere else.
# ============================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

project(AXIS VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ---- paths to the SDKs already on this machine -----------------------------
set(AXIS_JUCE_PATH "C:/workspace/JUCE"
    CACHE PATH "Path to the JUCE 9 source tree")
set(AXIS_CLAP_EXT_PATH "C:/workspace/clap-juce-extensions-main"
    CACHE PATH "Path to clap-juce-extensions")

if(NOT EXISTS "${AXIS_JUCE_PATH}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "JUCE not found at ${AXIS_JUCE_PATH}. "
        "Re-run cmake with -DAXIS_JUCE_PATH=<path to JUCE>")
endif()

add_subdirectory("${AXIS_JUCE_PATH}" JUCE EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(AXIS_FORMATS VST3 Standalone)

# ============================================================================
#  WebView2 SDK (Windows only)
#
#  JUCE's WebBrowserComponent needs Microsoft's WebView2 headers to compile,
#  and they do not ship with JUCE or with Visual Studio. The SDK is a NuGet
#  package, so it is fetched here at configure time and unpacked into the
#  build folder.
#
#  It is downloaded once; later configures reuse what is already unpacked.
#  To keep it across clean builds, point AXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR somewhere outside
#  the build folder.
# ============================================================================
set(AXIS_WEBVIEW2_VERSION "1.0.2792.45"
    CACHE STRING "Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet version to fetch")
set(AXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/webview2"
    CACHE PATH "Where the WebView2 SDK is unpacked")

set(AXIS_HAVE_WEBVIEW2 FALSE)

if(WIN32)
    set(_wv2_header "${AXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR}/build/native/include/WebView2.h")

    if(NOT EXISTS "${_wv2_header}")
        set(_wv2_zip "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/webview2.zip")

        set(_wv2_urls
            "https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package/Microsoft.Web.WebView2/${AXIS_WEBVIEW2_VERSION}"
            "https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package/Microsoft.Web.WebView2")

        foreach(_url IN LISTS _wv2_urls)
            message(STATUS "AXIS: downloading WebView2 SDK from ${_url}")

            file(DOWNLOAD "${_url}" "${_wv2_zip}"
                 STATUS _dl_status
                 TLS_VERIFY ON
                 SHOW_PROGRESS)

            list(GET _dl_status 0 _dl_code)

            if(_dl_code EQUAL 0)
                break()
            endif()

            list(GET _dl_status 1 _dl_msg)
            message(STATUS "AXIS: download failed (${_dl_msg})")
        endforeach()

        if(EXISTS "${_wv2_zip}")
            file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${AXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR}")
            file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_wv2_zip}"
                 DESTINATION "${AXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR}")
            file(REMOVE "${_wv2_zip}")
        endif()
    endif()

    if(EXISTS "${_wv2_header}")
        set(AXIS_HAVE_WEBVIEW2 TRUE)
        message(STATUS "AXIS: WebView2 SDK ready at ${AXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR}")
    else()
        message(WARNING
            "AXIS: the WebView2 SDK could not be fetched.\n"
            "The plugin will build, but the UI will fall back to the legacy "
            "Windows browser control and will not render correctly.\n"
            "Fix: download Microsoft.Web.WebView2 from nuget.org, unpack it "
            "(a .nupkg is a .zip), and re-run cmake with\n"
            "  -DAXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR=<folder containing build/native/include>")
    endif()
endif()

# ---- the plugin target -----------------------------------------------------
juce_add_plugin(AXIS
    COMPANY_NAME                "Fanan"
    BUNDLE_ID                   site.fananteam.axis
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE    Fnan
    PLUGIN_CODE                 Axis
    PRODUCT_NAME                "AXIS"
    DESCRIPTION                 "Modular guitar pedal family"

    IS_SYNTH                    FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT            FALSE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT           FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT              FALSE
    EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS TRUE
    NEEDS_WEB_BROWSER           TRUE

    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD     FALSE      # build folder only — never install

    FORMATS                     ${AXIS_FORMATS})

# ---- the web UI, embedded as binary data -----------------------------------
file(GLOB_RECURSE AXIS_UI_FILES
     "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/Resources/ui/*")

juce_add_binary_data(AXIS_WebUI
    HEADER_NAME "AxisWebUI.h"
    NAMESPACE   AxisWebUI
    SOURCES     ${AXIS_UI_FILES})

set_target_properties(AXIS_WebUI PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE TRUE)

# ---- sources ---------------------------------------------------------------
target_sources(AXIS PRIVATE
    src/Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
    src/Source/PluginEditor.cpp)

target_include_directories(AXIS PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/Source")

target_compile_definitions(AXIS PUBLIC
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=1
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0
    JUCE_REPORT_APP_USAGE=0)

# ---- wire the WebView2 SDK in --------------------------------------------
if(AXIS_HAVE_WEBVIEW2)
    target_compile_definitions(AXIS PUBLIC
        JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2=1
        JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2_WITH_STATIC_LINKING=1)

    target_include_directories(AXIS PUBLIC
        "${AXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR}/build/native/include")

    if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
        set(_wv2_arch x64)
    else()
        set(_wv2_arch x86)
    endif()

    set(_wv2_lib "${AXIS_WEBVIEW2_DIR}/build/native/${_wv2_arch}/WebView2LoaderStatic.lib")

    if(EXISTS "${_wv2_lib}")
        target_link_libraries(AXIS PRIVATE "${_wv2_lib}")
    else()
        message(WARNING "AXIS: WebView2LoaderStatic.lib not found at ${_wv2_lib}")
    endif()
endif()

target_link_libraries(AXIS PRIVATE
    AXIS_WebUI
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_gui_extra
    PUBLIC
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
    juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags)

# ---- CLAP ------------------------------------------------------------------
if(EXISTS "${AXIS_CLAP_EXT_PATH}/CMakeLists.txt")
    add_subdirectory("${AXIS_CLAP_EXT_PATH}" clap-juce-extensions EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    clap_juce_extensions_plugin(TARGET AXIS
        CLAP_ID "site.fananteam.axis"
        CLAP_FEATURES audio-effect distortion "guitar")
    message(STATUS "AXIS: CLAP target enabled")
else()
    message(STATUS "AXIS: clap-juce-extensions not found — CLAP target skipped")
endif()

// ============================================================================
//  AXIS — web UI
//
//  The same page the design was approved as, wired to the plugin. Opening this
//  file directly in a browser still works: without the native bridge every
//  control falls back to local state, which is what makes design iteration
//  cheap.
// ============================================================================

/* ── native bridge ───────────────────────────────────────── */
let Juce = null;

// The JUCE frontend library is served at the resource-provider ROOT, not next
// to this file. A relative "./juce/index.js" would resolve to /js/juce/index.js
// and — because the provider matches on filename — fetch THIS file again,
// recursing until the module graph dies and nothing on the page runs.
try {
  Juce = await import("/juce/index.js");
} catch (e) {
  console.log("AXIS: no native bridge, running as a design preview —", e && e.message);
}

const native = (name) => {
  if (Juce && typeof Juce.getNativeFunction === "function") {
    try { return Juce.getNativeFunction(name); } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
  }
  return async () => undefined;
};

const setParam     = native("axisSetParam");
const beginGesture = native("axisBeginGesture");
const endGesture   = native("axisEndGesture");
const getState     = native("axisGetState");
const setOrder     = native("axisSetChainOrder");
const loadCapture  = native("axisLoadCapture");

const onBackend = (event, fn) => {
  if (window.__JUCE__ && window.__JUCE__.backend)
    window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener(event, fn);
};

const byParam = {};
MODULES.forEach(m => {
  m.knobs.forEach(k => byParam[k.id] = { kind:"knob", module:m, def:k });
  m.buttons.forEach(b => byParam[b.id] = { kind:"button", module:m, def:b });
  byParam[m.fader.id] = { kind:"fader", module:m, def:m.fader };
  byParam[m.voice.id] = { kind:"voice", module:m, def:m.voice };
  byParam[m.bypassId] = { kind:"bypass", module:m };
});

/* ── formatting ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
const A0 = -225, A1 = 45;

const fmt = (d) => {
  const v = d.val, u = d.unit || "";
  if (u === "dB")  return (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + v.toFixed(1) + "dB";
  if (u === ":1")  return v.toFixed(1) + ":1";
  if (u === "ms" || u === "Hz") return Math.round(v) + " " + u;
  if (u === "%")   return Math.round(v) + "%";
  return Math.round(v);
};

/* ── knob widget ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
const ticks = (el, lg) => {
  const S = lg ? 124 : 90, C = S / 2, R = lg ? 58 : 42;
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
    const a = (A0 + (A1 - A0) * i / 10) * Math.PI / 180;
    const maj = i % 5 === 0, r0 = R - (maj ? 7 : 4.5);
    out += `<line x1="${C + r0 * Math.cos(a)}" y1="${C + r0 * Math.sin(a)}"
                  x2="${C + R  * Math.cos(a)}" y2="${C + R  * Math.sin(a)}"
                  stroke="${maj ? "rgba(255,248,232,.34)" : "rgba(255,248,232,.17)"}"
                  stroke-width="${maj ? 2 : 1.2}" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
  }
  el.innerHTML = out;
};

const liveKnobs = {};   // paramId -> repaint fn

const makeKnob = (k) => {
  const lg = k.size === "lg", S = lg ? 124 : 90;
  const n = document.createElement("div");
  n.className = "kb " + k.size;
  n.dataset.param = k.id;
  n.innerHTML =
    `<div class="dial">
       <svg class="ticks" viewBox="0 0 ${S} ${S}" width="${S}" height="${S}"></svg>
       <div class="bezel"></div><div class="body"></div><div class="flutes"></div>
       <div class="spec"></div><div class="rim"></div><div class="capdome"></div><div class="ptr"></div>
     </div>
     <div class="lbl engrave">${k.label}</div><div class="val"></div>`;

  ticks(n.querySelector(".ticks"), lg);

  const repaint = () => {
    const t = (k.val - k.min) / (k.max - k.min), ang = A0 + t * (A1 - A0);
    n.querySelector(".flutes").style.transform = `rotate(${ang + 90}deg)`;
    n.querySelector(".ptr").style.transform    = `rotate(${ang + 90}deg)`;
    n.querySelector(".val").textContent        = fmt(k);
  };
  repaint();
  liveKnobs[k.id] = repaint;

  let y0 = 0, v0 = 0, dragging = false;
  const dial = n.querySelector(".dial");

  dial.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    dragging = true; y0 = e.clientY; v0 = k.val;
    dial.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    beginGesture(k.id);
  });

  dial.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const step = (k.max - k.min) / 180 * (e.shiftKey ? 0.25 : 1);
    k.val = Math.max(k.min, Math.min(k.max, v0 + (y0 - e.clientY) * step));
    repaint();
    setParam(k.id, k.val);
  });

  const release = () => { if (dragging) { dragging = false; endGesture(k.id); } };
  dial.addEventListener("pointerup", release);
  dial.addEventListener("pointercancel", release);

  // industry conventions
  dial.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
    k.val = k.default !== undefined ? k.default : (k.min + k.max) / 2;
    repaint(); beginGesture(k.id); setParam(k.id, k.val); endGesture(k.id);
  });

  dial.addEventListener("click", e => {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
      k.val = k.default !== undefined ? k.default : (k.min + k.max) / 2;
      repaint(); beginGesture(k.id); setParam(k.id, k.val); endGesture(k.id);
    }
  });

  return n;
};

/* ── panel builder ───────────────────────────────────────── */
let current = MODULES.find(m => m.selected) || MODULES[0];
const liveButtons = {}, liveFaders = {}, liveVoices = {};

const buildPanel = (m) => {
  current = m;
  for (const key in liveKnobs)   delete liveKnobs[key];
  for (const key in liveButtons) delete liveButtons[key];
  for (const key in liveFaders)  delete liveFaders[key];
  for (const key in liveVoices)  delete liveVoices[key];

  document.getElementById("module-title").textContent = m.id;
  document.getElementById("module-sub").textContent   = m.sub;

  const seg = document.getElementById("voice-seg");
  seg.innerHTML = "";
  m.voice.options.forEach((o, i) => {
    const b = document.createElement("b");
    b.textContent = o;
    if (i === m.voice.index) b.classList.add("on");
    b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      m.voice.index = i;
      [...seg.children].forEach(x => x.classList.remove("on"));
      b.classList.add("on");
      beginGesture(m.voice.id); setParam(m.voice.id, i); endGesture(m.voice.id);
    });
    seg.appendChild(b);
  });
  liveVoices[m.voice.id] = () => {
    [...seg.children].forEach((x, i) => x.classList.toggle("on", i === m.voice.index));
  };

  const deck = document.getElementById("knob-row");
  deck.innerHTML = "";
  m.knobs.forEach(k => deck.appendChild(makeKnob(k)));

  const foot = document.getElementById("mfoot");
  foot.innerHTML = "";

  m.buttons.forEach(b => {
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "btn" + (b.on ? " on" : "");
    el.id = b.id;
    el.innerHTML = `<span class="jewel"></span>${b.label}`;
    el.addEventListener("click", () => {
      b.on = !b.on;
      el.classList.toggle("on", b.on);
      beginGesture(b.id); setParam(b.id, b.on ? 1 : 0); endGesture(b.id);
    });
    foot.appendChild(el);
    liveButtons[b.id] = () => el.classList.toggle("on", b.on);
  });

  const f = m.fader;
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "faderwrap";
  wrap.innerHTML =
    `<div class="lbl engrave">${f.label}</div>
     <div class="fader" id="${f.id}-slider"><div class="cap"></div></div>
     <div class="num" id="${f.id}-value"></div>`;
  foot.appendChild(wrap);

  const fd   = wrap.querySelector(".fader");
  const cap  = wrap.querySelector(".cap");
  const num  = wrap.querySelector(".num");

  const paintFader = () => {
    const t = (f.val - f.min) / (f.max - f.min);
    cap.style.left = (t * 100) + "%";
    num.textContent = fmt(f);
  };
  paintFader();
  liveFaders[f.id] = paintFader;

  let dragging = false;
  const setFromEvent = e => {
    const r = fd.getBoundingClientRect();
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width));
    f.val = f.min + t * (f.max - f.min);
    paintFader();
    setParam(f.id, f.val);
  };

  fd.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    dragging = true; fd.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    beginGesture(f.id); setFromEvent(e);
  });
  fd.addEventListener("pointermove", e => { if (dragging) setFromEvent(e); });
  const relFader = () => { if (dragging) { dragging = false; endGesture(f.id); } };
  fd.addEventListener("pointerup", relFader);
  fd.addEventListener("pointercancel", relFader);
};

    .map(el => el.dataset.index)

};

     <div class="lamp"></div>

     <div class="fsw"></div>`;

  p.addEventListener("click", () => {

    p.classList.add("sel");
    buildPanel(m);
  });

  p.querySelector(".fsw").addEventListener("click", e => {
    e.stopPropagation();

    p.classList.toggle("on", m.on);
    p.classList.toggle("off", !m.on);
    beginGesture(m.bypassId); setParam(m.bypassId, m.on ? 0 : 1); endGesture(m.bypassId);
  });

  // drag to reorder
  p.addEventListener("dragstart", e => {
    e.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", index);
    p.style.opacity = "0.45";
  });
  p.addEventListener("dragend", () => { p.style.opacity = ""; });
  p.addEventListener("dragover", e => e.preventDefault());
  p.addEventListener("drop", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const from = e.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain");
    const src  = chain.querySelector(`.stomp[data-index="${from}"]`);
    if (src && src !== p) {
      const all = [...chain.querySelectorAll(".stomp")];
      if (all.indexOf(src) < all.indexOf(p)) p.after(src);
      else                                   p.before(src);
      pushOrder();
    }
  });

  stompEls[m.id] = p;
  chain.appendChild(p);
});

chain.appendChild(cable());

add.className = "stomp add";

/* ── VU meters ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
const vuFace = (svg) => {
  const CX = 65, CY = 72, R = 54;
  let s = "";
  for (let i = 0; i <= 8; i++) {
    const a = (-150 + 120 * i / 8) * Math.PI / 180;
    const red = i >= 6, r0 = R - (i % 2 ? 4 : 7);
    s += `<line x1="${CX + r0 * Math.cos(a)}" y1="${CY + r0 * Math.sin(a)}"
                x2="${CX + R  * Math.cos(a)}" y2="${CY + R  * Math.sin(a)}"
                stroke="${red ? "#A62E1C" : "#4A3D20"}" stroke-width="${i % 2 ? 1 : 1.8}"/>`;
  }
  s += `<text x="${CX}" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7.5" fill="#6A5A33"
              font-family="Inter,sans-serif" letter-spacing="1.6">VU</text>`;
  s += `<g id="${svg.id}-n"><line x1="${CX}" y1="${CY}" x2="${CX}" y2="${CY - R + 3}"
           stroke="#1E1A12" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>`;
  s += `<circle cx="${CX}" cy="${CY}" r="5" fill="#2A2419"/>`;
  s += `<circle cx="${CX}" cy="${CY}" r="3" fill="#6E6450"/>`;
  svg.innerHTML = s;
};

/* ── state sync from the plugin ──────────────────────────── */
const applyState = (json) => {
  let st;
  try { st = typeof json === "string" ? JSON.parse(json) : json; }
  catch (e) { return; }

  for (const id in byParam) {
    if (!(id in st)) continue;
    const entry = byParam[id], v = st[id];

    if (entry.kind === "knob" || entry.kind === "fader") {
      entry.def.val = v;
      if (liveKnobs[id])  liveKnobs[id]();
      if (liveFaders[id]) liveFaders[id]();
    } else if (entry.kind === "button") {
      entry.def.on = v > 0.5;
      if (liveButtons[id]) liveButtons[id]();
    } else if (entry.kind === "voice") {
      entry.def.index = Math.round(v);
      if (liveVoices[id]) liveVoices[id]();
    } else if (entry.kind === "bypass") {
      const m = entry.module, el = stompEls[m.id];
      m.on = !(v > 0.5);
      if (el) { el.classList.toggle("on", m.on); el.classList.toggle("off", !m.on); }
    }
  }

  if (st.__meters) {
    needleIn  += (Math.min(1, st.__meters.in  * 1.6) - needleIn)  * 0.4;
    needleOut += (Math.min(1, st.__meters.out * 1.6) - needleOut) * 0.4;
    swing(vin, needleIn); swing(vout, needleOut);
  }

  if (st.__capture !== undefined)
    setCaptureName(st.__capture, !!st.__captureLoaded);
};

onBackend("axisUpdate", applyState);

getState().then(s => { if (s) applyState(s); }).catch(() => {});

#pragma once

#include <juce_dsp/juce_dsp.h>

namespace axis::dsp
{

/** AMP — the capture player.

    The tone stack, trim, presence and output stage are implemented here and
    working. The neural capture engine itself is NOT wired yet: `loadCapture`
    and `runCapture` are the two seams where NeuralAudio (MIT) drops in, and
    until it does the module runs as a clean tone-shaping stage so the rest of
    the chain can be built and heard.

    When the engine is added:
      - loadCapture()  parses the .nam file and builds the model
      - runCapture()   replaces the identity call in processBlock
      - setSlim()      selects the A2 slimmable width (40 / 60 / 100 %)
      - latencySamples() reports the model's receptive-field delay to the host
*/
class AmpCapture
{
public:
    enum class Slim { slim40 = 0, slim60, full };

    struct Params
    {
        Slim  slim       = Slim::slim60;
        float trimDb     = 0.0f;
        float bass       = 52.0f;
        float mid        = 48.0f;
        float treble     = 58.0f;
        float presence   = 44.0f;
        bool  cabSim     = true;
        bool  stackPost  = false;
        bool  doubler    = false;
        float output     = 72.0f;
        float micX       = 36.0f;
        float micY       = 50.0f;
    };

    void prepare (const juce::dsp::ProcessSpec& spec)
    {
        sampleRate  = spec.sampleRate;
        numChannels = (int) spec.numChannels;

        lowShelf .resize ((size_t) numChannels);
        midPeak  .resize ((size_t) numChannels);
        highShelf.resize ((size_t) numChannels);
        presPeak .resize ((size_t) numChannels);
        cabLow   .resize ((size_t) numChannels);
        cabHigh  .resize ((size_t) numChannels);

        doublerDelay.resize ((size_t) numChannels,
                             juce::dsp::DelayLine<float> (2048));

        for (auto& d : doublerDelay)
        {
            d.prepare (spec);
            d.setMaximumDelayInSamples (2048);
        }

        reset();
    }

    void reset()
    {
        for (auto& f : lowShelf)  f.reset();
        for (auto& f : midPeak)   f.reset();
        for (auto& f : highShelf) f.reset();
        for (auto& f : presPeak)  f.reset();
        for (auto& f : cabLow)    f.reset();
        for (auto& f : cabHigh)   f.reset();
        for (auto& d : doublerDelay) d.reset();
    }

    void setParams (const Params& p)
    {
        params = p;

        const float bassDb = juce::jmap (p.bass,     0.0f, 100.0f, -12.0f, 12.0f);
        const float midDb  = juce::jmap (p.mid,      0.0f, 100.0f, -10.0f, 10.0f);
        const float trebDb = juce::jmap (p.treble,   0.0f, 100.0f, -12.0f, 12.0f);
        const float presDb = juce::jmap (p.presence, 0.0f, 100.0f,  -6.0f, 10.0f);

        auto lowC  = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeLowShelf (
            sampleRate, 110.0, 0.72, juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (bassDb));
        auto midC  = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makePeakFilter (
            sampleRate, 650.0, 0.80, juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (midDb));
        auto highC = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeHighShelf (
            sampleRate, 3200.0, 0.70, juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (trebDb));
        auto presC = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makePeakFilter (
            sampleRate, 4200.0, 1.10, juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (presDb));

        // mic position: X moves from cone centre (bright) to edge (dark),
        // Y moves from on-axis to off-axis, which mostly costs top end
        const float axisDb = juce::jmap (p.micX, 0.0f, 100.0f,  4.0f, -7.0f);
        const float distDb = juce::jmap (std::abs (p.micY - 50.0f), 0.0f, 50.0f, 0.0f, -5.0f);

        auto cabLoC = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeHighPass (
            sampleRate, 78.0, 0.70);
        auto cabHiC = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeLowShelf (
            sampleRate, 3600.0, 0.60,
            juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (0.0f));

        auto cabTopC = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeHighShelf (
            sampleRate, 3400.0, 0.65,
            juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (axisDb + distDb));

        juce::ignoreUnused (cabHiC);

        for (int ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ++ch)
        {
            lowShelf [(size_t) ch].coefficients = lowC;
            midPeak  [(size_t) ch].coefficients = midC;
            highShelf[(size_t) ch].coefficients = highC;
            presPeak [(size_t) ch].coefficients = presC;
            cabLow   [(size_t) ch].coefficients = cabLoC;
            cabHigh  [(size_t) ch].coefficients = cabTopC;
        }

        const float dblMs = 11.0f + (p.micY * 0.06f);
        doublerSamples = dblMs * 0.001f * static_cast<float> (sampleRate);
    }

    void process (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer)
    {
        const int numCh = juce::jmin (numChannels, buffer.getNumChannels());
        const int numSm = buffer.getNumSamples();

        const float trim = juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (params.trimDb);
        const float out  = juce::jmap (params.output, 0.0f, 100.0f, 0.0f, 1.5f);

        for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
        {
            auto* d = buffer.getWritePointer (ch);

            for (int i = 0; i < numSm; ++i)
            {
                float x = d[i] * trim;

                if (! params.stackPost)
                    x = toneStack (ch, x);

                x = runCapture (ch, x);

                if (params.stackPost)
                    x = toneStack (ch, x);

                if (params.cabSim)
                {
                    x = cabLow [(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
                    x = cabHigh[(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
                }

                if (params.doubler && numCh > 1)
                {
                    auto& dl = doublerDelay[(size_t) ch];
                    dl.pushSample (0, x);
                    const float delayed = dl.popSample (
                        0, doublerSamples * (ch == 0 ? 1.0f : 1.37f));
                    x = 0.62f * x + 0.38f * delayed;
                }

                d[i] = x * out;
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    //  Capture engine seams — see the class comment
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Loads a .nam capture. Returns false until the engine is wired in. */
    bool loadCapture (const juce::File& namFile)
    {
        juce::ignoreUnused (namFile);
        capturePath = namFile.getFullPathName();
        captureLoaded = false;          // flip once NeuralAudio is linked
        return captureLoaded;
    }

    juce::String currentCaptureName() const
    {
        return capturePath.isEmpty() ? "NO CAPTURE LOADED"
                                     : juce::File (capturePath).getFileNameWithoutExtension();
    }

    bool  isCaptureLoaded() const noexcept { return captureLoaded; }
    int   latencySamples()  const noexcept { return captureLoaded ? modelLatency : 0; }

private:
    float toneStack (int ch, float x) noexcept
    {
        x = lowShelf [(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
        x = midPeak  [(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
        x = highShelf[(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
        x = presPeak [(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
        return x;
    }

    /** Identity until the neural engine lands. The signature is already the
        one the engine needs, so wiring it is a body swap, not a refactor. */
    float runCapture (int ch, float x) noexcept
    {
        juce::ignoreUnused (ch);
        return captureLoaded ? x : x;
    }

    double sampleRate  = 44100.0;
    int    numChannels = 2;
    Params params;

    using Filter = juce::dsp::IIR::Filter<float>;
    std::vector<Filter> lowShelf, midPeak, highShelf, presPeak, cabLow, cabHigh;
    std::vector<juce::dsp::DelayLine<float>> doublerDelay;

    float        doublerSamples = 480.0f;
    juce::String capturePath;
    bool         captureLoaded  = false;
    int          modelLatency   = 0;
};

} // namespace axis::dsp

#pragma once

#include <juce_dsp/juce_dsp.h>

namespace axis::dsp
{

/** Feed-forward compressor with three detector characters.

    OPTO  — program-dependent release, soft knee, slow
    FET   — fast attack, aggressive, hard-ish knee
    VCA   — clean and linear, exactly what the controls say
*/
class Comp
{
public:
    enum class Circuit { opto = 0, fet, vca };

    struct Params
    {
        Circuit circuit  = Circuit::opto;
        float threshDb   = -18.0f;
        float ratio      = 4.0f;
        float makeupDb   = 6.0f;
        float attackMs   = 14.0f;
        float releaseMs  = 280.0f;
        bool  autoGain   = true;
        bool  scHpf      = false;
        bool  parallel   = false;
        float mix        = 100.0f;
    };

    void prepare (const juce::dsp::ProcessSpec& spec)
    {
        sampleRate = spec.sampleRate;
        dry.setSize ((int) spec.numChannels, (int) spec.maximumBlockSize);

        hpf.prepare (spec);
        hpf.setType (juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilterType::highpass);
        hpf.setCutoffFrequency (120.0f);

        reset();
    }

    void reset()
    {
        hpf.reset();
        env = 0.0f;
        gr  = 1.0f;
        dry.clear();
    }

    void setParams (const Params& p)
    {
        params = p;

        float atk = p.attackMs, rel = p.releaseMs;

        switch (p.circuit)
        {
            case Circuit::opto: atk *= 1.6f;  rel *= 1.9f;  knee = 9.0f; break;
            case Circuit::fet:  atk *= 0.35f; rel *= 0.75f; knee = 3.0f; break;
            case Circuit::vca:  knee = 6.0f;  break;
        }

        attackCoeff  = coeff (juce::jmax (0.05f, atk));
        releaseCoeff = coeff (juce::jmax (5.0f,  rel));
    }

    void process (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer)
    {
        const int numCh = buffer.getNumChannels();
        const int numSm = buffer.getNumSamples();

        if (dry.getNumChannels() < numCh || dry.getNumSamples() < numSm)
            dry.setSize (numCh, numSm, false, false, true);

        for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
            dry.copyFrom (ch, 0, buffer, ch, 0, numSm);

        const float mixAmt = (params.parallel ? juce::jmin (0.5f, params.mix * 0.01f)
                                              : params.mix * 0.01f);
        float makeup = juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (params.makeupDb);

        if (params.autoGain)
        {
            // approximate the loss a given threshold/ratio costs and give it back
            const float est = (0.0f - params.threshDb) * (1.0f - 1.0f / params.ratio) * 0.45f;
            makeup *= juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (juce::jlimit (0.0f, 18.0f, est));
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < numSm; ++i)
        {
            float sc = 0.0f;
            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
                sc += buffer.getReadPointer (ch)[i];

            sc /= static_cast<float> (juce::jmax (1, numCh));

            if (params.scHpf)
                sc = hpf.processSample (0, sc);

            const float rect = std::abs (sc);
            const float c    = (rect > env) ? attackCoeff : releaseCoeff;
            env += (rect - env) * c;

            const float lvlDb = juce::Decibels::gainToDecibels (juce::jmax (1.0e-6f, env));
            const float over  = lvlDb - params.threshDb;

            float reduceDb = 0.0f;

            if (over > knee * 0.5f)
                reduceDb = over * (1.0f - 1.0f / params.ratio);
            else if (over > -knee * 0.5f)
            {
                const float t = over + knee * 0.5f;
                reduceDb = (1.0f - 1.0f / params.ratio) * (t * t) / (2.0f * knee);
            }

            gr = juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (-reduceDb);
            lastGrDb = -reduceDb;

            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
            {
                auto* d = buffer.getWritePointer (ch);
                const float wet = d[i] * gr * makeup;
                d[i] = dry.getSample (ch, i) * (1.0f - mixAmt) + wet * mixAmt;
            }
        }
    }

    float gainReductionDb() const noexcept { return lastGrDb; }

private:
    float coeff (float ms) const
    {
        return 1.0f - std::exp (-1.0f / (0.001f * ms * static_cast<float> (sampleRate)));
    }

    double sampleRate = 44100.0;
    Params params;

    juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilter<float> hpf;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> dry;

    float env = 0.0f, gr = 1.0f, lastGrDb = 0.0f;
    float attackCoeff = 0.1f, releaseCoeff = 0.01f, knee = 6.0f;
};
} // namespace axis::dsp

#pragma once

#include <juce_dsp/juce_dsp.h>

namespace axis::dsp
{

/** Transparent overdrive.

    The chain is: input gain -> body shelf -> asymmetric soft clip ->
    bite shelf -> tone tilt -> level, with a dry/wet mix across the whole lot.

    DYNAMIC TOUCH drives the clipper harder when you dig in and backs off when
    you play softly, which is what makes a real pedal feel alive rather than
    like a fixed transfer curve.
*/
class Drive
{
public:
    enum class Voice { warm = 0, open, tight };

    struct Params
    {
        Voice voice   = Voice::warm;
        float tone    = 42.0f;
        float gain    = 64.0f;
        float level   = 55.0f;
        float body    = 38.0f;
        float bite    = 71.0f;
        bool  dynamic = true;
        bool  stereo  = false;
        float mix     = 100.0f;
    };

    void prepare (const juce::dsp::ProcessSpec& spec)
    {
        sampleRate = spec.sampleRate;
        numChannels = (int) spec.numChannels;

        dry.setSize (numChannels, (int) spec.maximumBlockSize);

        bodyFilter.resize ((size_t) numChannels);
        biteFilter.resize ((size_t) numChannels);
        tiltLow.resize    ((size_t) numChannels);
        tiltHigh.resize   ((size_t) numChannels);

        reset();
    }

    void reset()
    {
        for (auto& f : bodyFilter) f.reset();
        for (auto& f : biteFilter) f.reset();
        for (auto& f : tiltLow)    f.reset();
        for (auto& f : tiltHigh)   f.reset();

        env = 0.0f;
        dry.clear();
    }

    void setParams (const Params& p)
    {
        params = p;

        // voice sets the clipper's asymmetry and the pre-emphasis corner
        switch (p.voice)
        {
            case Voice::warm:  asym = 0.22f; preHz = 480.0f;  drivePad = 1.0f;  break;
            case Voice::open:  asym = 0.08f; preHz = 320.0f;  drivePad = 0.86f; break;
            case Voice::tight: asym = 0.30f; preHz = 760.0f;  drivePad = 1.18f; break;
        }

        const float bodyDb = juce::jmap (p.body, 0.0f, 100.0f, -6.0f, 9.0f);
        const float biteDb = juce::jmap (p.bite, 0.0f, 100.0f, -5.0f, 8.0f);
        const float tiltDb = juce::jmap (p.tone, 0.0f, 100.0f, -7.0f, 7.0f);

        auto bodyCoeffs = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeLowShelf (
            sampleRate, 180.0, 0.7, juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (bodyDb));
        auto biteCoeffs = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeHighShelf (
            sampleRate, 2600.0, 0.7, juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (biteDb));
        auto tiltLoCoeffs = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeLowShelf (
            sampleRate, 700.0, 0.6, juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (-tiltDb));
        auto tiltHiCoeffs = juce::dsp::IIR::Coefficients<float>::makeHighShelf (
            sampleRate, 1800.0, 0.6, juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (tiltDb));

        for (int ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ++ch)
        {
            bodyFilter[(size_t) ch].coefficients = bodyCoeffs;
            biteFilter[(size_t) ch].coefficients = biteCoeffs;
            tiltLow   [(size_t) ch].coefficients = tiltLoCoeffs;
            tiltHigh  [(size_t) ch].coefficients = tiltHiCoeffs;
        }

        preCoeff = 1.0f - std::exp (-juce::MathConstants<float>::twoPi
                                    * preHz / static_cast<float> (sampleRate));
        envCoeff = 1.0f - std::exp (-1.0f / (0.012f * static_cast<float> (sampleRate)));
    }

    void process (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer)
    {
        const int numCh = juce::jmin (numChannels, buffer.getNumChannels());
        const int numSm = buffer.getNumSamples();

        if (dry.getNumChannels() < numCh || dry.getNumSamples() < numSm)
            dry.setSize (numCh, numSm, false, false, true);

        for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
            dry.copyFrom (ch, 0, buffer, ch, 0, numSm);

        const float driveAmt = juce::jmap (params.gain, 0.0f, 100.0f, 1.0f, 48.0f) * drivePad;
        const float outGain  = juce::jmap (params.level, 0.0f, 100.0f, 0.0f, 1.6f);
        const float mixAmt   = params.mix * 0.01f;

        for (int i = 0; i < numSm; ++i)
        {
            // one shared envelope so both channels breathe together unless
            // TRUE STEREO is on
            float det = 0.0f;
            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
                det = juce::jmax (det, std::abs (buffer.getReadPointer (ch)[i]));

            env += (det - env) * envCoeff;

            const float touch = params.dynamic
                ? juce::jlimit (0.55f, 1.65f, 0.75f + env * 2.6f)
                : 1.0f;

            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
            {
                auto* d = buffer.getWritePointer (ch);
                float x = d[i];

                x = bodyFilter[(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
                x = clip (x * driveAmt * touch);
                x = biteFilter[(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
                x = tiltLow  [(size_t) ch].processSample (x);
                x = tiltHigh [(size_t) ch].processSample (x);

                const float wet = x * outGain;
                d[i] = dry.getSample (ch, i) * (1.0f - mixAmt) + wet * mixAmt;
            }
        }
    }

private:
    /** Asymmetric soft clip. The offset pushes the positive and negative
        halves through different parts of the curve, which is where the even
        harmonics — the "warmth" — come from. */
    float clip (float x) const noexcept
    {
        const float biased = x + asym;
        const float y      = std::tanh (biased) - std::tanh (asym);
        return y * 0.72f;
    }

    double sampleRate = 44100.0;
    int    numChannels = 2;
    Params params;

    using Filter = juce::dsp::IIR::Filter<float>;

    std::vector<Filter> bodyFilter, biteFilter, tiltLow, tiltHigh;
    juce::AudioBuffer<float> dry;

    float asym = 0.22f, preHz = 480.0f, drivePad = 1.0f;
    float preCoeff = 0.1f, envCoeff = 0.01f, env = 0.0f;
};

} // namespace axis::dsp

#pragma once

#include <juce_dsp/juce_dsp.h>

namespace axis::dsp
{

/** Adaptive noise gate.

    Sidechain is high-passed so palm-muted low end doesn't hold the gate open,
    and ADAPT mode tracks the noise floor during quiet passages so the
    threshold follows the rig instead of a fixed number.
*/
class Gate
{
public:
    enum class Mode { fast = 0, smooth, adapt };

    struct Params
    {
        Mode  mode      = Mode::adapt;
        float threshDb  = -46.0f;
        float depth     = 88.0f;   // 0..100
        float releaseMs = 160.0f;
        float holdMs    = 40.0f;
        float scHpfHz   = 120.0f;
        bool  hissFilter = true;
        bool  autoLearn  = false;
        float range     = 100.0f;  // 0..100
    };

    void prepare (const juce::dsp::ProcessSpec& spec)
    {
        sampleRate = spec.sampleRate;

        scHpf.prepare (spec);
        scHpf.setType (juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilterType::highpass);

        hiss.prepare (spec);
        hiss.setType (juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilterType::lowpass);
        hiss.setCutoffFrequency (9500.0f);

        reset();
    }

    void reset()
    {
        scHpf.reset();
        hiss.reset();
        env      = 0.0f;
        gain     = 1.0f;
        holdLeft = 0;
        floorEst = 1.0e-4f;
    }

    void setParams (const Params& p)
    {
        params = p;
        scHpf.setCutoffFrequency (juce::jlimit (20.0f, 2000.0f, p.scHpfHz));

        const float atkMs = (p.mode == Mode::fast) ? 0.4f : 2.0f;
        attackCoeff  = coeff (atkMs);
        releaseCoeff = coeff (juce::jmax (1.0f, p.releaseMs));
        holdSamples  = static_cast<int> (p.holdMs * 0.001 * sampleRate);
        detCoeff     = coeff ((p.mode == Mode::fast) ? 1.0f : 6.0f);
    }

    void process (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer)
    {
        const int numCh = buffer.getNumChannels();
        const int numSm = buffer.getNumSamples();

        const float threshLin = juce::Decibels::decibelsToGain (effectiveThreshold());
        const float floorGain = 1.0f - (params.depth * 0.01f) * (params.range * 0.01f);

        for (int i = 0; i < numSm; ++i)
        {
            // ---- detector: mono sum, high-passed ----
            float sc = 0.0f;
            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
                sc += buffer.getReadPointer (ch)[i];

            sc /= static_cast<float> (juce::jmax (1, numCh));
            sc  = scHpf.processSample (0, sc);

            const float rect = std::abs (sc);
            env += (rect - env) * detCoeff;

            // ---- adaptive floor tracking ----
            if (params.mode == Mode::adapt || params.autoLearn)
            {
                if (env < floorEst) floorEst += (env - floorEst) * 0.0008f;
                else                floorEst += (env - floorEst) * 0.000012f;
            }

            // ---- gate decision ----
            const bool open = env > threshLin;

            if (open)
                holdLeft = holdSamples;
            else if (holdLeft > 0)
                --holdLeft;

            const float target = (open || holdLeft > 0) ? 1.0f : floorGain;
            const float c      = (target > gain) ? attackCoeff : releaseCoeff;
            gain += (target - gain) * c;

            // ---- apply ----
            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
            {
                auto* d = buffer.getWritePointer (ch);
                float x = d[i] * gain;

                if (params.hissFilter && gain < 0.999f)
                    x = hiss.processSample (ch, x);

                d[i] = x;
            }
        }
    }

    float currentGain() const noexcept { return gain; }

private:
    float coeff (float ms) const
    {
        return 1.0f - std::exp (-1.0f / (0.001f * ms * static_cast<float> (sampleRate)));
    }

    float effectiveThreshold() const
    {
        if (params.mode != Mode::adapt && ! params.autoLearn)
            return params.threshDb;

        // sit a fixed margin above the tracked noise floor, but never below
        // the user's own setting by more than 12 dB
        const float floorDb = juce::Decibels::gainToDecibels (juce::jmax (1.0e-6f, floorEst));
        return juce::jlimit (params.threshDb - 12.0f, 0.0f, floorDb + 9.0f);
    }

    double sampleRate = 44100.0;
    Params params;

    juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilter<float> scHpf, hiss;

    float env = 0.0f, gain = 1.0f, floorEst = 1.0e-4f;
    float attackCoeff = 0.5f, releaseCoeff = 0.01f, detCoeff = 0.1f;
    int   holdSamples = 0, holdLeft = 0;
};

} // namespace axis::dsp

Size: 8.77 KB

#pragma once

#include <juce_dsp/juce_dsp.h>

namespace axis::dsp
{

/** SPACE — plate / hall / spring reverb.

    Four damped comb filters into two allpasses per channel, with a pre-delay
    in front. SPRING adds a short dispersive allpass chain, which is what gives
    a real spring tank its boing; PLATE runs denser and brighter; HALL runs
    longer with more damping.

    DUCK pulls the tail down while you're playing and lets it back up in the
    gaps, so the reverb never sits on top of the notes.
*/
class Space
{
public:
    enum class Type { plate = 0, hall, spring };

    struct Params
    {
        Type  type     = Type::spring;
        float preDlyMs = 24.0f;
        float decay    = 46.0f;
        float size     = 58.0f;
        float damp     = 62.0f;
        float width    = 80.0f;
        bool  shimmer  = false;
        bool  freeze   = false;
        bool  duck     = true;
        float mix      = 28.0f;
    };

    void prepare (const juce::dsp::ProcessSpec& spec)
    {
        sampleRate  = spec.sampleRate;
        numChannels = juce::jmax (1, (int) spec.numChannels);

        dry.setSize (numChannels, (int) spec.maximumBlockSize);

        preDelay.resize ((size_t) numChannels);
        for (auto& d : preDelay)
        {
            d.prepare (spec);
            d.setMaximumDelayInSamples ((int) (0.3 * sampleRate) + 8);
        }

        combs.assign ((size_t) numChannels, {});
        allpasses.assign ((size_t) numChannels, {});
        springs.assign ((size_t) numChannels, {});

        for (int ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ++ch)
        {
            for (int c = 0; c < numCombs; ++c)
                combs[(size_t) ch][(size_t) c].prepare (sampleRate, baseComb[c] * (ch == 0 ? 1.0 : 1.021));

            for (int a = 0; a < numAllpass; ++a)
                allpasses[(size_t) ch][(size_t) a].prepare (sampleRate, baseAllpass[a] * (ch == 0 ? 1.0 : 1.017));

            for (int s = 0; s < numSprings; ++s)
                springs[(size_t) ch][(size_t) s].prepare (sampleRate, baseSpring[s] * (ch == 0 ? 1.0 : 1.011));
        }

        reset();
    }

    void reset()
    {
        for (auto& d : preDelay) d.reset();
        for (auto& chCombs : combs)      for (auto& c : chCombs) c.reset();
        for (auto& chAps   : allpasses)  for (auto& a : chAps)   a.reset();
        for (auto& chSpr   : springs)    for (auto& s : chSpr)   s.reset();
        duckEnv = 0.0f;
        dry.clear();
    }

    void setParams (const Params& p)
    {
        params = p;

        float sizeScale = juce::jmap (p.size, 0.0f, 100.0f, 0.55f, 1.85f);
        float fb        = juce::jmap (p.decay, 0.0f, 100.0f, 0.62f, 0.94f);
        float dampAmt   = juce::jmap (p.damp, 0.0f, 100.0f, 0.02f, 0.78f);

        switch (p.type)
        {
            case Type::plate:  sizeScale *= 0.78f; dampAmt *= 0.70f; break;
            case Type::hall:   sizeScale *= 1.32f; fb = juce::jmin (0.965f, fb * 1.04f); break;
            case Type::spring: sizeScale *= 0.62f; dampAmt *= 1.15f; break;
        }

        if (p.freeze)
        {
            fb      = 0.999f;
            dampAmt = 0.01f;
        }

        for (int ch = 0; ch < numChannels; ++ch)
        {
            for (int c = 0; c < numCombs; ++c)
                combs[(size_t) ch][(size_t) c].set (sizeScale, fb, dampAmt);

            for (int a = 0; a < numAllpass; ++a)
                allpasses[(size_t) ch][(size_t) a].set (sizeScale, 0.5f);

            for (int s = 0; s < numSprings; ++s)
                springs[(size_t) ch][(size_t) s].set (1.0f, 0.62f);
        }

        preDelaySamples = p.preDlyMs * 0.001f * static_cast<float> (sampleRate);
        duckCoeff = 1.0f - std::exp (-1.0f / (0.030f * static_cast<float> (sampleRate)));
    }

    void process (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer)
    {
        const int numCh = juce::jmin (numChannels, buffer.getNumChannels());
        const int numSm = buffer.getNumSamples();

        if (dry.getNumChannels() < numCh || dry.getNumSamples() < numSm)
            dry.setSize (numCh, numSm, false, false, true);

        for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
            dry.copyFrom (ch, 0, buffer, ch, 0, numSm);

        const float mixAmt   = params.mix * 0.01f;
        const float widthAmt = params.width * 0.01f;
        const bool  useSpring = (params.type == Type::spring);

        for (int i = 0; i < numSm; ++i)
        {
            // duck from the dry input, not the wet tail
            float det = 0.0f;
            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
                det = juce::jmax (det, std::abs (dry.getSample (ch, i)));

            duckEnv += (det - duckEnv) * duckCoeff;

            const float duckGain = params.duck
                ? juce::jlimit (0.28f, 1.0f, 1.0f - duckEnv * 2.2f)
                : 1.0f;

            float wet[2] = { 0.0f, 0.0f };

            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh && ch < 2; ++ch)
            {
                auto& pd = preDelay[(size_t) ch];
                pd.pushSample (0, dry.getSample (ch, i));
                float x = pd.popSample (0, preDelaySamples);

                float sum = 0.0f;
                for (int c = 0; c < numCombs; ++c)
                    sum += combs[(size_t) ch][(size_t) c].process (x);

                sum *= 0.25f;

                for (int a = 0; a < numAllpass; ++a)
                    sum = allpasses[(size_t) ch][(size_t) a].process (sum);

                if (useSpring)
                    for (int s = 0; s < numSprings; ++s)
                        sum = springs[(size_t) ch][(size_t) s].process (sum);

                wet[ch] = sum * duckGain;
            }

            // mid/side width on the tail only
            if (numCh > 1)
            {
                const float mid  = (wet[0] + wet[1]) * 0.5f;
                const float side = (wet[0] - wet[1]) * 0.5f * widthAmt;
                wet[0] = mid + side;
                wet[1] = mid - side;
            }

            for (int ch = 0; ch < numCh; ++ch)
            {
                auto* d = buffer.getWritePointer (ch);
                d[i] = dry.getSample (ch, i) * (1.0f - mixAmt)
                     + wet[juce::jmin (ch, 1)] * mixAmt;
            }
        }
    }

private:
    // ---- building blocks ----
    struct Comb
    {
        void prepare (double sr, double ms)
        {
            maxLen = (int) (sr * ms * 0.001 * 2.0) + 4;
            buf.assign ((size_t) maxLen, 0.0f);
            baseLen = (int) (sr * ms * 0.001);
            len = baseLen;
            idx = 0;
        }

        void reset() { std::fill (buf.begin(), buf.end(), 0.0f); store = 0.0f; idx = 0; }

        void set (float sizeScale, float feedback, float damping)
        {
            len  = juce::jlimit (4, maxLen - 1, (int) (baseLen * sizeScale));
            fb   = feedback;
            damp = damping;
        }

        float process (float x) noexcept
        {
            const float y = buf[(size_t) idx];
            store = y * (1.0f - damp) + store * damp;
            buf[(size_t) idx] = x + store * fb;

            if (++idx >= len) idx = 0;
            return y;
        }

        std::vector<float> buf;
        int   maxLen = 0, baseLen = 0, len = 0, idx = 0;
        float fb = 0.8f, damp = 0.3f, store = 0.0f;
    };

    struct Allpass
    {
        void prepare (double sr, double ms)
        {
            maxLen = (int) (sr * ms * 0.001 * 2.0) + 4;
            buf.assign ((size_t) maxLen, 0.0f);
            baseLen = (int) (sr * ms * 0.001);
            len = baseLen;
            idx = 0;
        }

        void reset() { std::fill (buf.begin(), buf.end(), 0.0f); idx = 0; }

        void set (float sizeScale, float gain)
        {
            len = juce::jlimit (4, maxLen - 1, (int) (baseLen * sizeScale));
            g   = gain;
        }

        float process (float x) noexcept
        {
            const float bufOut = buf[(size_t) idx];
            const float y      = -x + bufOut;
            buf[(size_t) idx]  = x + bufOut * g;

            if (++idx >= len) idx = 0;
            return y;
        }

        std::vector<float> buf;
        int   maxLen = 0, baseLen = 0, len = 0, idx = 0;
        float g = 0.5f;
    };

    static constexpr int numCombs   = 4;
    static constexpr int numAllpass = 2;
    static constexpr int numSprings = 3;

    static constexpr double baseComb[numCombs]       = { 29.7, 37.1, 41.1, 43.7 };
    static constexpr double baseAllpass[numAllpass]  = { 5.0, 1.7 };
    static constexpr double baseSpring[numSprings]   = { 4.2, 3.1, 2.3 };

    double sampleRate  = 44100.0;
    int    numChannels = 2;
    Params params;

    std::vector<juce::dsp::DelayLine<float>> preDelay;
    std::vector<std::array<Comb, numCombs>>      combs;
    std::vector<std::array<Allpass, numAllpass>> allpasses;
    std::vector<std::array<Allpass, numSprings>> springs;

    juce::AudioBuffer<float> dry;
    float preDelaySamples = 1000.0f, duckEnv = 0.0f, duckCoeff = 0.01f;
};

} // namespace axis::dsp

// ---- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
inline juce::NormalisableRange<float> linear (float lo, float hi)
{
    return { lo, hi };
}

/** Range skewed so the lower values get more of the travel — right for times
    and frequencies, where the useful detail sits at the bottom. */
inline juce::NormalisableRange<float> skewed (float lo, float hi, float centre)
{
    juce::NormalisableRange<float> r { lo, hi };
    r.setSkewForCentre (centre);
    return r;
}

inline std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioParameterFloat> makeFloat (
    juce::StringRef id, juce::StringRef name,
    juce::NormalisableRange<float> range, float def, juce::StringRef unit)
{
    return std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterFloat> (
        juce::ParameterID { id, 1 }, name, range, def,
        juce::AudioParameterFloatAttributes().withLabel (unit));
}

inline std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioParameterBool> makeBool (
    juce::StringRef id, juce::StringRef name, bool def)
{
    return std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterBool> (
        juce::ParameterID { id, 1 }, name, def);
}

inline std::unique_ptr<juce::AudioParameterChoice> makeChoice (
    juce::StringRef id, juce::StringRef name,
    juce::StringArray options, int def)
{
    return std::make_unique<juce::AudioParameterChoice> (
        juce::ParameterID { id, 1 }, name, std::move (options), def);
}

#include "PluginEditor.h"
#include "AxisWebUI.h"

namespace
{
    constexpr int defaultWidth  = 1120;
    constexpr int defaultHeight = 680;

    /** Resolves a requested path such as "/js/index.js" to the embedded
        resource whose original filename matches its basename.

        Binary data is flat — it keeps filenames, not folders — so matching is
        by basename. That makes collisions possible, which is why anything
        under /juce/ is refused here: those requests belong to JUCE's own
        frontend library, and answering them with a file of ours would hand the
        page the wrong script. */
    const char* findResource (const juce::String& path, int& sizeOut)
    {
        if (path.startsWithIgnoreCase ("/juce/"))
            return nullptr;

        const auto wanted = path.fromLastOccurrenceOf ("/", false, false);

        for (int i = 0; i < AxisWebUI::namedResourceListSize; ++i)
        {
            const auto* name = AxisWebUI::namedResourceList[i];

            if (juce::String (AxisWebUI::getNamedResourceOriginalFilename (name))
                    .equalsIgnoreCase (wanted))
                return AxisWebUI::getNamedResource (name, sizeOut);
        }

        return nullptr;
    }

    juce::String mimeFor (const juce::String& path)
    {
        if (path.endsWithIgnoreCase (".html")) return "text/html";
        if (path.endsWithIgnoreCase (".js"))   return "text/javascript";
        if (path.endsWithIgnoreCase (".css"))  return "text/css";
        if (path.endsWithIgnoreCase (".svg"))  return "image/svg+xml";
        if (path.endsWithIgnoreCase (".png"))  return "image/png";
        if (path.endsWithIgnoreCase (".woff2"))return "font/woff2";
        return "application/octet-stream";
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

AxisAudioProcessorEditor::AxisAudioProcessorEditor (AxisAudioProcessor& p)
    : juce::AudioProcessorEditor (&p), proc (p)
{
    using Options = juce::WebBrowserComponent::Options;

    auto options = Options{}
        .withBackend (Options::Backend::webview2)
        .withWinWebView2Options (
            Options::WinWebView2{}
                .withUserDataFolder (juce::File::getSpecialLocation (
                    juce::File::tempDirectory)))
        .withNativeIntegrationEnabled()
        .withResourceProvider ([this] (const auto& url) { return provide (url); })
        .withNativeFunction ("axisSetParam",
            [this] (auto& args, auto complete) { complete (handleSetParam (args)); })
        .withNativeFunction ("axisBeginGesture",
            [this] (auto& args, auto complete) { complete (handleGesture (args, true)); })
        .withNativeFunction ("axisEndGesture",
            [this] (auto& args, auto complete) { complete (handleGesture (args, false)); })
        .withNativeFunction ("axisGetState",
            [this] (auto& args, auto complete) { complete (handleGetState (args)); })
        .withNativeFunction ("axisSetChainOrder",
            [this] (auto& args, auto complete) { complete (handleChainOrder (args)); })
        .withNativeFunction ("axisLoadCapture",
            [this] (auto& args, auto complete) { complete (handleLoadCapture (args)); });

    web = std::make_unique<juce::WebBrowserComponent> (options);
    addAndMakeVisible (*web);

    web->goToURL (juce::WebBrowserComponent::getResourceProviderRoot());

    setResizable (true, true);
    getConstrainer()->setFixedAspectRatio ((double) defaultWidth / (double) defaultHeight);
    setResizeLimits (defaultWidth / 2, defaultHeight / 2,
                     defaultWidth * 2, defaultHeight * 2);
    setSize (defaultWidth, defaultHeight);

    startTimerHz (24);
}

AxisAudioProcessorEditor::~AxisAudioProcessorEditor()
{
    stopTimer();
}

void AxisAudioProcessorEditor::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    g.fillAll (juce::Colour (0xff0a0c0f));
}

void AxisAudioProcessorEditor::resized()
{
    if (web != nullptr)
        web->setBounds (getLocalBounds());
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

std::optional<juce::WebBrowserComponent::Resource>
AxisAudioProcessorEditor::provide (const juce::String& url)
{
    const auto path = (url == "/" || url.isEmpty()) ? juce::String ("/index.html") : url;

    int size = 0;
    if (const auto* data = findResource (path, size))
    {
        std::vector<std::byte> bytes (static_cast<size_t> (size));
        std::memcpy (bytes.data(), data, static_cast<size_t> (size));
        return juce::WebBrowserComponent::Resource { std::move (bytes), mimeFor (path) };
    }

    return std::nullopt;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

juce::var AxisAudioProcessorEditor::handleSetParam (const juce::Array<juce::var>& args)
{
    if (args.size() < 2)
        return juce::var (false);

    const auto id  = args[0].toString();
    const auto val = static_cast<float> (args[1]);

    if (auto* param = proc.state().getParameter (id))
    {
        const auto norm = param->getNormalisableRange().convertTo0to1 (val);
        param->setValueNotifyingHost (juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, norm));
        return juce::var (true);
    }

    return juce::var (false);
}

juce::var AxisAudioProcessorEditor::handleGesture (const juce::Array<juce::var>& args,
                                                   bool begin)
{
    if (args.isEmpty())
        return juce::var (false);

    if (auto* param = proc.state().getParameter (args[0].toString()))
    {
        if (begin) param->beginChangeGesture();
        else       param->endChangeGesture();
        return juce::var (true);
    }

    return juce::var (false);
}

juce::String AxisAudioProcessorEditor::buildStateJson() const
{
    auto* obj = new juce::DynamicObject();

    for (auto* p : proc.getParameters())
    {
        if (auto* withId = dynamic_cast<juce::AudioProcessorParameterWithID*> (p))
        {
            const auto id = withId->paramID;

            if (auto* ranged = dynamic_cast<juce::RangedAudioParameter*> (p))
                obj->setProperty (id, ranged->convertFrom0to1 (ranged->getValue()));
        }
    }

    auto* meters = new juce::DynamicObject();
    meters->setProperty ("in",  proc.inputLevel());
    meters->setProperty ("out", proc.outputLevel());
    obj->setProperty ("__meters", juce::var (meters));

    juce::StringArray orderParts;
    for (auto v : proc.chainOrder())
        orderParts.add (juce::String (v));

    obj->setProperty ("__chainOrder", orderParts.joinIntoString (","));

    auto& ampRef = const_cast<AxisAudioProcessor&> (proc).ampModule();
    obj->setProperty ("__capture", ampRef.currentCaptureName());
    obj->setProperty ("__captureLoaded", ampRef.isCaptureLoaded());

    return juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (obj), true);
}

juce::var AxisAudioProcessorEditor::handleGetState (const juce::Array<juce::var>&)
{
    uiReady = true;
    return juce::var (buildStateJson());
}

juce::var AxisAudioProcessorEditor::handleChainOrder (const juce::Array<juce::var>& args)
{
    if (args.isEmpty())
        return juce::var (false);

    juce::StringArray parts;
    parts.addTokens (args[0].toString(), ",", "");

    if (parts.size() != axis::numModules)
        return juce::var (false);

    std::array<int, axis::numModules> newOrder {};
    for (int i = 0; i < axis::numModules; ++i)
        newOrder[(size_t) i] = juce::jlimit (0, axis::numModules - 1, parts[i].getIntValue());

    proc.setChainOrder (newOrder);
    return juce::var (true);
}

juce::var AxisAudioProcessorEditor::handleLoadCapture (const juce::Array<juce::var>&)
{
    chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> (
        "Load a NAM capture", juce::File(), "*.nam");

    chooser->launchAsync (
        juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles,
        [this] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
        {
            const auto file = fc.getResult();

            if (file.existsAsFile())
            {
                proc.ampModule().loadCapture (file);

                if (web != nullptr)
                    web->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible (
                        "axisCapture", juce::var (proc.ampModule().currentCaptureName()));
            }
        });

    return juce::var (true);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

void AxisAudioProcessorEditor::timerCallback()
{
    if (! uiReady || web == nullptr)
        return;

    // one push per frame carries both the meters and any parameter the host
    // moved behind the UI's back (automation, a control surface, undo)
    web->emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible ("axisUpdate", juce::var (buildStateJson()));
}

#pragma once

#include <juce_gui_extra/juce_gui_extra.h>

#include "PluginProcessor.h"

/** The editor is a thin shell around a WebBrowserComponent.

    All of the UI lives in Resources/ui and is embedded as binary data, so the
    plugin has no external files at runtime. The native side exposes a small,
    generic bridge rather than one relay per parameter — with 54 parameters
    that is both less code and less to keep in sync.
*/
class AxisAudioProcessorEditor : public juce::AudioProcessorEditor,
                                 private juce::Timer
{
public:
    explicit AxisAudioProcessorEditor (AxisAudioProcessor&);
    ~AxisAudioProcessorEditor() override;

    void resized() override;
    void paint (juce::Graphics&) override;

private:
    void timerCallback() override;

    std::optional<juce::WebBrowserComponent::Resource> provide (const juce::String& url);

    juce::var handleSetParam     (const juce::Array<juce::var>& args);
    juce::var handleGesture      (const juce::Array<juce::var>& args, bool begin);
    juce::var handleGetState     (const juce::Array<juce::var>& args);
    juce::var handleChainOrder   (const juce::Array<juce::var>& args);
    juce::var handleLoadCapture  (const juce::Array<juce::var>& args);

    juce::String buildStateJson() const;

    AxisAudioProcessor& proc;

    std::unique_ptr<juce::WebBrowserComponent> web;
    std::unique_ptr<juce::FileChooser> chooser;

    bool uiReady = false;

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (AxisAudioProcessorEditor)
};

#include "PluginProcessor.h"
#include "PluginEditor.h"

using namespace axis;

namespace
{
    float getFloat (juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState& s, juce::StringRef id)
    {
        if (auto* p = s.getRawParameterValue (id))
            return p->load();

        jassertfalse;
        return 0.0f;
    }

    bool getBool (juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState& s, juce::StringRef id)
    {
        return getFloat (s, id) > 0.5f;
    }

    int getChoice (juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState& s, juce::StringRef id)
    {
        return static_cast<int> (getFloat (s, id));
    }
}

AxisAudioProcessor::AxisAudioProcessor()
    : juce::AudioProcessor (BusesProperties()
          .withInput  ("Input",  juce::AudioChannelSet::stereo(), true)
          .withOutput ("Output", juce::AudioChannelSet::stereo(), true)),
      apvts (*this, nullptr, "AXIS", createLayout())
{
    apvts.state.setProperty ("chainOrder", "0,1,2,3,4", nullptr);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

void AxisAudioProcessor::prepareToPlay (double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock)
{
    juce::dsp::ProcessSpec spec {
        sampleRate,
        static_cast<juce::uint32> (samplesPerBlock),
        static_cast<juce::uint32> (juce::jmax (1, getTotalNumOutputChannels()))
    };

    gate .prepare (spec);
    comp .prepare (spec);
    drive.prepare (spec);
    amp  .prepare (spec);
    space.prepare (spec);

    meterInSm = meterOutSm = 0.0f;
    setLatencySamples (amp.latencySamples());
}

void AxisAudioProcessor::releaseResources()
{
    gate.reset();  comp.reset();  drive.reset();
    amp.reset();   space.reset();
}

bool AxisAudioProcessor::isBusesLayoutSupported (const BusesLayout& layouts) const
{
    const auto& out = layouts.getMainOutputChannelSet();
    const auto& in  = layouts.getMainInputChannelSet();

    if (out != juce::AudioChannelSet::mono() && out != juce::AudioChannelSet::stereo())
        return false;

    // mono-in / stereo-out is normal for a guitar rig
    return in == out || (in == juce::AudioChannelSet::mono()
                         && out == juce::AudioChannelSet::stereo());
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

void AxisAudioProcessor::pullParams()
{
    using namespace axis::pid;

    // ---- GATE ----
    axis::dsp::Gate::Params g;
    g.mode       = static_cast<axis::dsp::Gate::Mode> (getChoice (apvts, gateMode));
    g.threshDb   = getFloat  (apvts, gateThresh);
    g.depth      = getFloat  (apvts, gateDepth);
    g.releaseMs  = getFloat  (apvts, gateRelease);
    g.holdMs     = getFloat  (apvts, gateHold);
    g.scHpfHz    = getFloat  (apvts, gateScHpf);
    g.hissFilter = getBool   (apvts, gateHiss);
    g.autoLearn  = getBool   (apvts, gateLearn);
    g.range      = getFloat  (apvts, gateRange);
    gate.setParams (g);

    // ---- COMP ----
    axis::dsp::Comp::Params c;
    c.circuit   = static_cast<axis::dsp::Comp::Circuit> (getChoice (apvts, compCircuit));
    c.threshDb  = getFloat (apvts, compThresh);
    c.ratio     = getFloat (apvts, compRatio);
    c.makeupDb  = getFloat (apvts, compMakeup);
    c.attackMs  = getFloat (apvts, compAttack);
    c.releaseMs = getFloat (apvts, compRelease);
    c.autoGain  = getBool  (apvts, compAuto);
    c.scHpf     = getBool  (apvts, compScHpf);
    c.parallel  = getBool  (apvts, compParal);
    c.mix       = getFloat (apvts, compMix);
    comp.setParams (c);

    // ---- DRIVE ----
    axis::dsp::Drive::Params d;
    d.voice   = static_cast<axis::dsp::Drive::Voice> (getChoice (apvts, drvVoice));
    d.tone    = getFloat (apvts, drvTone);
    d.gain    = getFloat (apvts, drvGain);
    d.level   = getFloat (apvts, drvLevel);
    d.body    = getFloat (apvts, drvBody);
    d.bite    = getFloat (apvts, drvBite);
    d.dynamic = getBool  (apvts, drvDynamic);
    d.stereo  = getBool  (apvts, drvStereo);
    d.mix     = getFloat (apvts, drvMix);
    drive.setParams (d);

    // ---- AMP ----
    axis::dsp::AmpCapture::Params a;
    a.slim      = static_cast<axis::dsp::AmpCapture::Slim> (getChoice (apvts, ampSlim));
    a.trimDb    = getFloat (apvts, ampTrim);
    a.bass      = getFloat (apvts, ampBass);
    a.mid       = getFloat (apvts, ampMid);
    a.treble    = getFloat (apvts, ampTreble);
    a.presence  = getFloat (apvts, ampPresence);
    a.cabSim    = getBool  (apvts, ampCab);
    a.stackPost = getBool  (apvts, ampStack);
    a.doubler   = getBool  (apvts, ampDbl);
    a.output    = getFloat (apvts, ampOutput);
    a.micX      = getFloat (apvts, cabMicX);
    a.micY      = getFloat (apvts, cabMicY);
    amp.setParams (a);

    // ---- SPACE ----
    axis::dsp::Space::Params s;
    s.type     = static_cast<axis::dsp::Space::Type> (getChoice (apvts, spcType));
    s.preDlyMs = getFloat (apvts, spcPredly);
    s.decay    = getFloat (apvts, spcDecay);
    s.size     = getFloat (apvts, spcSize);
    s.damp     = getFloat (apvts, spcDamp);
    s.width    = getFloat (apvts, spcWidth);
    s.shimmer  = getBool  (apvts, spcShimmer);
    s.freeze   = getBool  (apvts, spcFreeze);
    s.duck     = getBool  (apvts, spcDuck);
    s.mix      = getFloat (apvts, spcMix);
    space.setParams (s);
}

void AxisAudioProcessor::processBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer,
                                       juce::MidiBuffer&)
{
    juce::ScopedNoDenormals noDenormals;

    const int numIn  = getTotalNumInputChannels();
    const int numOut = getTotalNumOutputChannels();
    const int numSm  = buffer.getNumSamples();

    // mono guitar into a stereo rig: fan the input out first
    if (numIn == 1 && numOut > 1)
        for (int ch = 1; ch < numOut; ++ch)
            buffer.copyFrom (ch, 0, buffer, 0, 0, numSm);

    for (int ch = numIn; ch < numOut && numIn > 1; ++ch)
        buffer.clear (ch, 0, numSm);

    pullParams();

    // ---- input meter ----
    {
        const float mag = buffer.getMagnitude (0, numSm);
        meterInSm += (mag - meterInSm) * 0.2f;
        meterIn.store (meterInSm);
    }

    // ---- run the chain in the user's order ----
    std::array<int, axis::numModules> localOrder;
    {
        const juce::ScopedLock sl (orderLock);
        localOrder = order;
    }

    using namespace axis::pid;

    for (int slot = 0; slot < axis::numModules; ++slot)
    {
        switch (localOrder[(size_t) slot])
        {
            case 0: if (! getBool (apvts, gateBypass))  gate .process (buffer); break;
            case 1: if (! getBool (apvts, compBypass))  comp .process (buffer); break;
            case 2: if (! getBool (apvts, drvBypass))   drive.process (buffer); break;
            case 3: if (! getBool (apvts, ampBypass))   amp  .process (buffer); break;
            case 4: if (! getBool (apvts, spcBypass))   space.process (buffer); break;
            default: break;
        }
    }

    // ---- output meter + safety ----
    {
        const float mag = buffer.getMagnitude (0, numSm);
        meterOutSm += (mag - meterOutSm) * 0.2f;
        meterOut.store (meterOutSm);
    }

    for (int ch = 0; ch < numOut; ++ch)
    {
        auto* d = buffer.getWritePointer (ch);

        for (int i = 0; i < numSm; ++i)
            if (! std::isfinite (d[i]))
                d[i] = 0.0f;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

std::array<int, axis::numModules> AxisAudioProcessor::chainOrder() const
{
    const juce::ScopedLock sl (orderLock);
    return order;
}

void AxisAudioProcessor::setChainOrder (const std::array<int, axis::numModules>& newOrder)
{
    juce::StringArray parts;

    {
        const juce::ScopedLock sl (orderLock);
        order = newOrder;

        for (auto v : order)
            parts.add (juce::String (v));
    }

    apvts.state.setProperty ("chainOrder", parts.joinIntoString (","), nullptr);
}

void AxisAudioProcessor::getStateInformation (juce::MemoryBlock& destData)
{
    if (auto xml = apvts.copyState().createXml())
        copyXmlToBinary (*xml, destData);
}

void AxisAudioProcessor::setStateInformation (const void* data, int sizeInBytes)
{
    if (auto xml = getXmlFromBinary (data, sizeInBytes))
    {
        apvts.replaceState (juce::ValueTree::fromXml (*xml));

        const auto str = apvts.state.getProperty ("chainOrder", "0,1,2,3,4").toString();
        juce::StringArray parts;
        parts.addTokens (str, ",", "");

        if (parts.size() == axis::numModules)
        {
            std::array<int, axis::numModules> loaded {};
            for (int i = 0; i < axis::numModules; ++i)
                loaded[(size_t) i] = juce::jlimit (0, axis::numModules - 1,
                                                   parts[i].getIntValue());

            const juce::ScopedLock sl (orderLock);
            order = loaded;
        }
    }
}

juce::AudioProcessorEditor* AxisAudioProcessor::createEditor()
{
    return new AxisAudioProcessorEditor (*this);
}

juce::AudioProcessor* JUCE_CALLTYPE createPluginFilter()
{
    return new AxisAudioProcessor();
}

#pragma once

#include <juce_audio_processors/juce_audio_processors.h>
#include <juce_dsp/juce_dsp.h>

#include "Parameters.h"
#include "dsp/Gate.h"
#include "dsp/Comp.h"
#include "dsp/Drive.h"
#include "dsp/AmpCapture.h"
#include "dsp/Space.h"

class AxisAudioProcessor : public juce::AudioProcessor
{
public:
    AxisAudioProcessor();
    ~AxisAudioProcessor() override = default;

    // ---- AudioProcessor ----
    void prepareToPlay (double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock) override;
    void releaseResources() override;
    bool isBusesLayoutSupported (const BusesLayout& layouts) const override;
    void processBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>&, juce::MidiBuffer&) override;

    juce::AudioProcessorEditor* createEditor() override;
    bool hasEditor() const override { return true; }

    const juce::String getName() const override { return "AXIS"; }

    bool acceptsMidi()  const override { return false; }
    bool producesMidi() const override { return false; }
    bool isMidiEffect() const override { return false; }
    double getTailLengthSeconds() const override { return 6.0; }

    int getNumPrograms() override { return 1; }
    int getCurrentProgram() override { return 0; }
    void setCurrentProgram (int) override {}
    const juce::String getProgramName (int) override { return "Default"; }
    void changeProgramName (int, const juce::String&) override {}

    void getStateInformation (juce::MemoryBlock&) override;
    void setStateInformation (const void*, int) override;

    // ---- AXIS ----
    juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState& state() noexcept { return apvts; }

    /** Chain order as module indices, e.g. {0,1,2,3,4}. Owned by the editor's
        drag-to-reorder and persisted with the plugin state. */
    std::array<int, axis::numModules> chainOrder() const;
    void setChainOrder (const std::array<int, axis::numModules>& order);

    /** Metering, read by the UI. */
    float inputLevel()  const noexcept { return meterIn.load();  }
    float outputLevel() const noexcept { return meterOut.load(); }

    axis::dsp::AmpCapture& ampModule() noexcept { return amp; }

private:
    void pullParams();

    juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState apvts;

    axis::dsp::Gate       gate;
    axis::dsp::Comp       comp;
    axis::dsp::Drive      drive;
    axis::dsp::AmpCapture amp;
    axis::dsp::Space      space;

    std::atomic<float> meterIn { 0.0f }, meterOut { 0.0f };
    float meterInSm = 0.0f, meterOutSm = 0.0f;

    juce::CriticalSection orderLock;
    std::array<int, axis::numModules> order { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 };

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (AxisAudioProcessor)
};

# C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\CMakeLists.txt
# =============================================================================
# NATURA - Sonify modeling synth (13 archetypes, articulations, Grex synthesis)
#
# Built against JUCE 9.  All sources live flat in src\.
# Every build product stays inside this project's build folder: no copy or
# install step to the system plugin folders.
#
# CLAP: JUCE 9.0.1 has no CLAP of its own, so it comes from
# clap-juce-extensions when that folder is found (it is optional - without it
# the VST3 and the Standalone still build).
# =============================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(Natura VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ---- JUCE -------------------------------------------------------------------
if(NOT DEFINED JUCE_DIR OR "${JUCE_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    if(DEFINED JUCE_PATH AND EXISTS "${JUCE_PATH}/CMakeLists.txt")
        set(JUCE_DIR "${JUCE_PATH}" CACHE PATH "Path to JUCE")
    elseif(EXISTS "C:/workspace/JUCE/CMakeLists.txt")
        set(JUCE_DIR "C:/workspace/JUCE" CACHE PATH "Path to JUCE")
    elseif(EXISTS "D:/workspace/JUCE/CMakeLists.txt")
        set(JUCE_DIR "D:/workspace/JUCE" CACHE PATH "Path to JUCE")
    elseif(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/JUCE/CMakeLists.txt")
        set(JUCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/JUCE" CACHE PATH "Path to JUCE")
    endif()
endif()
if(NOT JUCE_DIR OR NOT EXISTS "${JUCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "JUCE not found. Pass -DJUCE_DIR=C:/workspace/JUCE")
endif()

# ---- clap-juce-extensions (optional) ----------------------------------------
if(NOT DEFINED CLAP_EXTENSIONS_DIR OR "${CLAP_EXTENSIONS_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    foreach(cand
            "${CLAP_EXTENSIONS_PATH}"
            "C:/workspace/clap-juce-extensions-main"
            "C:/workspace/libs/CLAP_Extensions"
            "D:/workspace/clap-juce-extensions-main"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/clap-juce-extensions")
        if(cand AND EXISTS "${cand}/CMakeLists.txt")
            set(CLAP_EXTENSIONS_DIR "${cand}" CACHE PATH "Path to clap-juce-extensions")
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
set(NATURA_HAVE_CLAP FALSE)
if(CLAP_EXTENSIONS_DIR AND EXISTS "${CLAP_EXTENSIONS_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    set(NATURA_HAVE_CLAP TRUE)
endif()

set(CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD OFF)
add_subdirectory("${JUCE_DIR}" JUCE)

if(NATURA_HAVE_CLAP)
    set(CLAP_JUCE_EXTENSIONS_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CLAP_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CLAP_HELPERS_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory("${CLAP_EXTENSIONS_DIR}" clap-juce-extensions EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    message(STATUS "Natura: CLAP from ${CLAP_EXTENSIONS_DIR}")
else()
    message(STATUS "Natura: clap-juce-extensions not found - building VST3 + Standalone only")
endif()

# ---- the plugin ---------------------------------------------------------------
juce_add_plugin(Natura
    COMPANY_NAME "Fanan"
    BUNDLE_ID com.fanan.natura
    IS_SYNTH TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
    EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS FALSE
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD FALSE
    VST3_AUTO_MANIFEST FALSE
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Fnan
    PLUGIN_CODE Ntra
    VST3_CATEGORIES Instrument Synth
    AU_MAIN_TYPE kAudioUnitType_MusicDevice
    HARDENED_RUNTIME_ENABLED TRUE
    FORMATS VST3 Standalone
    PRODUCT_NAME "Natura"
)

if(NATURA_HAVE_CLAP)

        CLAP_ID "com.fanan.natura"
        CLAP_FEATURES instrument synthesizer

endif()

juce_generate_juce_header(Natura)

target_sources(Natura PRIVATE

    src/ModelBase.h
    src/OscEngine.h
    src/ModelsKeys.h
