// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\Archetypes.h
#pragma once
//==============================================================================
//  Archetypes.h  -  the root model of every archetype, its own controls, and
//  the factory presets edited from those roots.
//
//  ROOT MODEL: choosing an archetype on the panel loads its root - every
//  control back to the values that make that mechanism sound like itself.
//  FACTORY PRESETS: GM-oriented instruments, each one a root plus the few
//  moves that turn it into that instrument (Air Jet -> Recorder, ...).
//==============================================================================
#include "Params.h"
#include "Articulations.h"
#include <vector>

namespace natura
{
    //==========================================================================
    //  The archetype-specific controls, in each model's spec order.
    //==========================================================================
    struct SpecList { int count; P ids[kMaxSpec]; };

    inline const SpecList& specsFor (Archetype a)
    {
        static const SpecList lists[kNumArchetypes] = {
            { 7,  { P::ss_hammerpos, P::ss_strings, P::ss_detune, P::ss_symp, P::ss_keyoff, P::ss_pedalnoise, P::ss_lid } },
            { 7,  { P::ep_type, P::ep_chime, P::ep_pickup, P::ep_bark, P::ep_tremrate, P::ep_tremdepth, P::ep_keyoff } },
            { 6,  { P::sb_mallet, P::sb_material, P::sb_strike, P::sb_tube, P::sb_motorrate, P::sb_motordepth } },
            { 15, { P::tw_db1, P::tw_db2, P::tw_db3, P::tw_db4, P::tw_db5, P::tw_db6, P::tw_db7, P::tw_db8, P::tw_db9,
                    P::tw_click, P::tw_leak, P::tw_perc, P::tw_percdecay, P::tw_percvol, P::tw_vib } },
            { 9,  { P::po_principal, P::po_flute, P::po_reed, P::po_mixture, P::po_bourdon, P::po_chiff, P::po_wind, P::po_tremrate, P::po_tremdepth } },
            { 5,  { P::fr_bellows, P::fr_register, P::fr_musette, P::fr_tone, P::fr_chamber } },
            { 10, { P::pl_position, P::pl_plectrum, P::pl_fret, P::pl_mute, P::pl_pickup, P::pl_ring, P::pl_amp, P::pl_drive, P::pl_amptone, P::pl_keyoff } },
            { 5,  { P::bw_pressure, P::bw_speed, P::bw_position, P::bw_rosin, P::bw_attack } },
            { 7,  { P::lr_tension, P::lr_growl, P::lr_bell, P::lr_mute, P::lr_wah, P::lr_bore, P::lr_buzz } },
            { 5,  { P::sr_stiffness, P::sr_bite, P::sr_bore, P::sr_subtone, P::sr_click } },
            { 5,  { P::dr_stiffness, P::dr_bite, P::dr_nasal, P::dr_bore, P::dr_click } },

    /** The synth archetype's own page, grouped as it is shown. */
    inline const std::vector<P>& synthOsc1()  { static const std::vector<P> v { P::s1_wave, P::s1_oct, P::s1_semi, P::s1_fine, P::s1_pw, P::s1_level }; return v; }
    inline const std::vector<P>& synthOsc2()  { static const std::vector<P> v { P::s2_wave, P::s2_oct, P::s2_semi, P::s2_fine, P::s2_pw, P::s2_level }; return v; }
    inline const std::vector<P>& synthMix()   { static const std::vector<P> v { P::sy_fm, P::sy_ring, P::sy_sync, P::sy_sub, P::sy_noise, P::sy_drive }; return v; }
    inline const std::vector<P>& synthLadder(){ static const std::vector<P> v { P::sy_cutoff, P::sy_reso, P::sy_key, P::sy_env, P::sy_vel }; return v; }
    inline const std::vector<P>& synthLadEnv(){ static const std::vector<P> v { P::sy_a, P::sy_d, P::sy_s, P::sy_r, P::sy_level }; return v; }

    /** A parameter's plain value as the 0..1 a model's spec slot expects. */
    inline float toSpec (P p, float v)
    {
        const auto& in = info (p);
        return juce::jlimit (0.0f, 1.0f, (v - in.minV) / std::max (1.0e-6f, in.maxV - in.minV));
    }

    /** Does this archetype listen to this shared EXCITER / RESONATOR control?
        (Body, character and unison apply to every archetype.)  The panel
        dims the ones that do nothing for the instrument on screen. */
    inline bool usesShared (Archetype a, P p)
    {
        using A = Archetype;
        switch (p)
        {
            case P::exc_strength:  return a != A::Tonewheel && a != A::PipeOrgan && a != A::FreeReed;
            case P::exc_hardness:  return a == A::StruckString || a == A::TineEP || a == A::StruckBar || a == A::BowedString
                                       || a == A::LipReed || a == A::Synth || a == A::AirJet;
            case P::exc_noise:     return a != A::TineEP && a != A::Tonewheel && a != A::PipeOrgan;
            case P::exc_transient: return a == A::Tonewheel || a == A::PipeOrgan || a == A::FreeReed || a == A::LipReed
                                       || a == A::SingleReed || a == A::DoubleReed || a == A::AirJet;
            case P::res_decay:     return a == A::StruckString || a == A::TineEP || a == A::StruckBar || a == A::PluckedString
                                       || a == A::BowedString || a == A::LipReed || a == A::Synth;
            case P::res_damping:   return a == A::StruckString || a == A::TineEP || a == A::StruckBar || a == A::PluckedString
                                       || a == A::BowedString || a == A::LipReed || a == A::AirJet || a == A::Synth;
            case P::res_inharm:    return a == A::StruckString || a == A::PluckedString || a == A::Synth;
            case P::res_oddeven:   return a == A::Synth;
            default:               return true;
        }
    }

    /** Every parameter at its archetype's root value. */
    inline std::vector<float> rootValues (Archetype a)
    {
        std::vector<float> v ((size_t) kNumParams);
        for (int i = 0; i < kNumParams; ++i) v[(size_t) i] = info (i).defV;
        v[(size_t) P::archetype] = (float) (int) a;
        for (const auto& o : rootOverrides (a)) v[(size_t) o.first] = o.second;
        return v;
    }

    inline std::vector<float> factoryValues (const Factory& f)
    {
        auto v = rootValues (f.arch);
        for (const auto& o : f.ov) v[(size_t) o.first] = o.second;
        return v;
    }
}

// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\Articulations.h
#pragma once
//==============================================================================
//  Articulations.h  -  what each archetype can be told to play, and how.
//
//  An articulation is either a NOTE articulation (it shapes the notes played
//  while it is selected: staccato, fall, pizzicato...) or a STATE articulation
//  (it flips something that lasts: rotor fast, motor off, sostenuto...).
//
//  Selection, in order of priority:
//      AUTO       overlapping notes -> Legato / Hammer-on, fast repeats -> Staccato
//      VELOCITY   below / above the split -> two chosen articulations
//      KEYSWITCH  a reserved octave of keys, or CC ZONES on a chosen CC
//      PANEL      the ARTIC tab (and its host parameter)
//==============================================================================
#include "Models.h"

namespace natura
{
    enum class Art
    {
        Normal, Legato, Detache, Staccato, Spiccato, Marcato, Sfz, Tremolo, Pizzicato, ColLegno,
        Harmonics, Trill, Fall, Doit, Scoop, Shake, Flutter, Growl, MuteStraight, MuteCup,
        MuteHarmon, MuteWah, Subtone, Overblow, PalmMute, Slide, HammerOn, Bend, DeadNote,
        Pedal, HalfPedal, Sostenuto, UnaCorda, DeadStroke, Roll, SoftMallet, HardMallet,
        MotorOn, MotorOff, RotorSlow, RotorFast, PercOn, PercOff, VibOn, VibOff,
        BellowsShake, RegisterUp, RegisterDown, GlideLegato, Retrigger, Sustain
    };

    constexpr int kMaxArts = 14;

    inline const char* artName (Art a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
            case Art::Normal:       return "NORMAL";
            case Art::Legato:       return "LEGATO";
            case Art::Detache:      return "DETACHE";
            case Art::Staccato:     return "STACCATO";
            case Art::Spiccato:     return "SPICCATO";
            case Art::Marcato:      return "MARCATO";
            case Art::Sfz:          return "SFORZANDO";
            case Art::Tremolo:      return "TREMOLO";
            case Art::Pizzicato:    return "PIZZICATO";
            case Art::ColLegno:     return "COL LEGNO";
            case Art::Harmonics:    return "HARMONICS";
            case Art::Trill:        return "TRILL";
            case Art::Fall:         return "FALL";
            case Art::Doit:         return "DOIT";
            case Art::Scoop:        return "SCOOP";
            case Art::Shake:        return "SHAKE";
            case Art::Flutter:      return "FLUTTER";
            case Art::Growl:        return "GROWL";
            case Art::MuteStraight: return "STRAIGHT MUTE";
            case Art::MuteCup:      return "CUP MUTE";
            case Art::MuteHarmon:   return "HARMON MUTE";
            case Art::MuteWah:      return "WAH MUTE";
            case Art::Subtone:      return "SUBTONE";
            case Art::Overblow:     return "OVERBLOW";
            case Art::PalmMute:     return "PALM MUTE";
            case Art::Slide:        return "SLIDE";
            case Art::HammerOn:     return "HAMMER-ON";
            case Art::Bend:         return "BEND";
            case Art::DeadNote:     return "DEAD NOTE";
            case Art::Pedal:        return "PEDAL";
            case Art::HalfPedal:    return "HALF PEDAL";
            case Art::Sostenuto:    return "SOSTENUTO";
            case Art::UnaCorda:     return "UNA CORDA";
            case Art::DeadStroke:   return "DEAD STROKE";
            case Art::Roll:         return "ROLL";
            case Art::SoftMallet:   return "SOFT MALLET";
            case Art::HardMallet:   return "HARD MALLET";
            case Art::MotorOn:      return "MOTOR ON";
            case Art::MotorOff:     return "MOTOR OFF";
            case Art::RotorSlow:    return "ROTOR SLOW";
            case Art::RotorFast:    return "ROTOR FAST";
            case Art::PercOn:       return "PERC ON";
            case Art::PercOff:      return "PERC OFF";
            case Art::VibOn:        return "VIB/CHO ON";
            case Art::VibOff:       return "VIB/CHO OFF";
            case Art::BellowsShake: return "BELLOWS SHAKE";
            case Art::RegisterUp:   return "REGISTER UP";
            case Art::RegisterDown: return "REGISTER DOWN";
            case Art::GlideLegato:  return "GLIDE LEGATO";
            case Art::Retrigger:    return "RETRIGGER";
            case Art::Sustain:      return "SUSTAIN";
            default:                return "?";
        }
    }

    /** True when selecting it flips a lasting state rather than shaping notes. */
    inline bool isStateArt (Art a)
    {
        switch (a)
        {
            case Art::MotorOn: case Art::MotorOff: case Art::RotorSlow: case Art::RotorFast:
            case Art::PercOn: case Art::PercOff: case Art::VibOn: case Art::VibOff:
            case Art::RegisterUp: case Art::RegisterDown: case Art::Sostenuto:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    struct ArtList { int count; Art arts[kMaxArts]; };

    inline const ArtList& artsFor (Archetype a)
    {
        static const ArtList lists[kNumArchetypes] = {
            /* STRUCK STRING */ { 5,  { Art::Normal, Art::Pedal, Art::HalfPedal, Art::Sostenuto, Art::UnaCorda } },
            /* TINE EP       */ { 4,  { Art::Normal, Art::Pedal, Art::HalfPedal, Art::Sostenuto } },
            /* STRUCK BAR    */ { 7,  { Art::Normal, Art::DeadStroke, Art::Roll, Art::SoftMallet, Art::HardMallet, Art::MotorOn, Art::MotorOff } },
            /* TONEWHEEL     */ { 6,  { Art::RotorSlow, Art::RotorFast, Art::PercOn, Art::PercOff, Art::VibOn, Art::VibOff } },
            /* PIPE ORGAN    */ { 2,  { Art::Normal, Art::Staccato } },
            /* FREE REED     */ { 4,  { Art::Normal, Art::BellowsShake, Art::RegisterUp, Art::RegisterDown } },
            /* PLUCKED       */ { 7,  { Art::Sustain, Art::PalmMute, Art::Harmonics, Art::Slide, Art::HammerOn, Art::Bend, Art::DeadNote } },
            /* BOWED         */ { 11, { Art::Legato, Art::Detache, Art::Staccato, Art::Spiccato, Art::Marcato, Art::Sfz, Art::Tremolo,
                                        Art::Pizzicato, Art::ColLegno, Art::Harmonics, Art::Trill } },
            /* LIP REED      */ { 14, { Art::Legato, Art::Staccato, Art::Marcato, Art::Sfz, Art::Fall, Art::Doit, Art::Scoop,
                                        Art::Shake, Art::Flutter, Art::Growl, Art::MuteStraight, Art::MuteCup, Art::MuteHarmon, Art::MuteWah } },
            /* SINGLE REED   */ { 9,  { Art::Legato, Art::Staccato, Art::Flutter, Art::Growl, Art::Subtone, Art::Overblow, Art::Trill, Art::Fall, Art::Scoop } },
            /* DOUBLE REED   */ { 9,  { Art::Legato, Art::Staccato, Art::Flutter, Art::Growl, Art::Subtone, Art::Overblow, Art::Trill, Art::Fall, Art::Scoop } },
            /* AIR JET       */ { 9,  { Art::Legato, Art::Staccato, Art::Flutter, Art::Growl, Art::Subtone, Art::Overblow, Art::Trill, Art::Fall, Art::Scoop } },
            /* SYNTH         */ { 3,  { Art::Normal, Art::GlideLegato, Art::Retrigger } }
        };
        return lists[(int) a];
    }

    inline Art artAt (Archetype a, int index)
    {
        const auto& l = artsFor (a);
        return l.arts[std::min (l.count - 1, std::max (0, index))];
    }

    inline int findArt (Archetype a, Art want)
    {
        const auto& l = artsFor (a);
        for (int i = 0; i < l.count; ++i) if (l.arts[i] == want) return i;
        return -1;
    }

    //==========================================================================
    //  What a NOTE articulation does to the voice.
    //==========================================================================
    enum class PitchFx { None, Scoop, Fall, Doit, Bend, Shake, Trill, Slide };

    struct ArtFx
    {
        float   velMul       = 1.0f;
        float   transientAdd = 0.0f;
        float   brightAdd    = 0.0f;
        float   noiseAdd     = 0.0f;
        float   dampAdd      = 0.0f;
        float   decayMul     = 1.0f;
        float   attackMul    = 1.0f;     // drive-envelope attack
        float   autoRelMs    = 0.0f;     // > 0: the note lets go by itself (staccato)
        float   releaseMinS  = 0.0f;     // amp release at least this long (falls, doits)
        float   releaseMaxS  = 0.0f;     // > 0: amp release at most this long (staccato)
        float   accent       = 0.0f;     // drive overshoot at the attack (marcato)
        bool    sfz          = false;    // strong attack, then drop and hold low
        float   amRate       = 0.0f;     // drive AM (bowed tremolo, bellows shake)
        float   amDepth      = 0.0f;
        float   growl        = 0.0f;     // rough modulation of the drive
        float   flutter      = 0.0f;
        float   freqMul      = 1.0f;     // harmonics / overblow
        bool    harmonic     = false;    // plucked: excite at the node
        bool    softPluck    = false;    // hammer-on in poly
        bool    roll         = false;
        bool    forceLegato  = false;
        bool    forceRetrig  = false;
        float   pedal        = -1.0f;    // >= 0: this damper position for these notes
        float   soft         = 0.0f;
        float   overblowSpec = -1.0f;    // air jet: physical overblow
        float   subtoneSpec  = -1.0f;    // single reed subtone
        PitchFx pitch        = PitchFx::None;
        Excite  excite       = Excite::Normal;
        Mute    mute         = Mute::Open;
    };

    inline ArtFx artFx (Art a, Archetype arch)
    {
        ArtFx f;
        switch (a)
        {
            case Art::Legato:       f.transientAdd = -0.35f; f.attackMul = 1.4f; break;
            case Art::Detache:      f.transientAdd = 0.25f; f.attackMul = 0.7f; break;
            case Art::Staccato:     f.autoRelMs = 110.0f; f.releaseMaxS = 0.09f; f.transientAdd = 0.3f; f.attackMul = 0.5f; break;
            case Art::Spiccato:     f.autoRelMs = 55.0f;  f.releaseMaxS = 0.06f; f.transientAdd = 0.45f; f.attackMul = 0.35f; f.velMul = 0.9f; break;
            case Art::Marcato:      f.accent = 0.45f; f.transientAdd = 0.4f; f.velMul = 1.2f; f.attackMul = 0.5f; break;
            case Art::Sfz:          f.sfz = true; f.transientAdd = 0.5f; f.attackMul = 0.4f; break;
            case Art::Tremolo:      f.amRate = 1.0f; f.amDepth = 0.75f; break;
            case Art::Pizzicato:    f.excite = Excite::Pluck; f.releaseMaxS = 0.35f; break;
            case Art::ColLegno:     f.excite = Excite::Strike; f.releaseMaxS = 0.25f; break;
            case Art::Harmonics:
                if (arch == Archetype::PluckedString) { f.harmonic = true; f.brightAdd = 0.2f; }
                else { f.freqMul = 2.0f; f.brightAdd = -0.25f; f.velMul = 0.8f; }
                break;
            case Art::Trill:        f.pitch = PitchFx::Trill; break;
            case Art::Fall:         f.pitch = PitchFx::Fall; f.releaseMinS = 0.45f; break;
            case Art::Doit:         f.pitch = PitchFx::Doit; f.releaseMinS = 0.4f; break;
            case Art::Scoop:        f.pitch = PitchFx::Scoop; break;
            case Art::Shake:        f.pitch = PitchFx::Shake; break;
            case Art::Flutter:      f.flutter = 0.6f; break;
            case Art::Growl:        f.growl = 0.55f; f.brightAdd = 0.1f; break;
            case Art::MuteStraight: f.mute = Mute::Straight; break;
            case Art::MuteCup:      f.mute = Mute::Cup; break;
            case Art::MuteHarmon:   f.mute = Mute::Harmon; break;
            case Art::MuteWah:      f.mute = Mute::Wah; break;
            case Art::Subtone:      f.brightAdd = -0.55f; f.noiseAdd = 0.3f; f.subtoneSpec = 0.85f; f.velMul = 0.85f; break;
            case Art::Overblow:
                if (arch == Archetype::AirJet) f.overblowSpec = 1.0f;
                else f.freqMul = 2.0f;
                f.brightAdd = 0.25f; f.noiseAdd = 0.1f;
                break;
            case Art::PalmMute:     f.dampAdd = 0.65f; f.brightAdd = -0.3f; break;
            case Art::Slide:        f.pitch = PitchFx::Slide; f.forceLegato = true; break;
            case Art::HammerOn:     f.forceLegato = true; f.softPluck = true; break;
            case Art::Bend:         f.pitch = PitchFx::Bend; break;
            case Art::DeadNote:     f.excite = Excite::Strike; f.dampAdd = 1.0f; f.releaseMaxS = 0.08f; break;
            case Art::Pedal:        f.pedal = 1.0f; break;
            case Art::HalfPedal:    f.pedal = 0.5f; break;
            case Art::UnaCorda:     f.soft = 1.0f; f.brightAdd = -0.2f; f.velMul = 0.92f; break;
            case Art::DeadStroke:   f.dampAdd = 0.92f; break;
            case Art::Roll:         f.roll = true; break;
            case Art::SoftMallet:   f.brightAdd = -0.5f; break;
            case Art::HardMallet:   f.brightAdd = 0.5f; break;
            case Art::BellowsShake: f.amRate = 0.4f; f.amDepth = 0.6f; break;
            case Art::GlideLegato:  f.forceLegato = true; break;
            case Art::Retrigger:    f.forceRetrig = true; break;
            default: break;
        }
        return f;
    }
}

// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\FananLookAndFeel.cpp
#include "FananLookAndFeel.h"

#if HAS_BINARY_DATA
 #include <BinaryData.h>
#endif

FananLookAndFeel::FananLookAndFeel()
{
    using namespace Theme::Color;

    // ComboBox / dropdowns ---------------------------------------------------
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::backgroundColourId,        bgInput);
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::textColourId,              textPrimary);
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::outlineColourId,           border);
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::arrowColourId,             textSecondary);
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::buttonColourId,            bgInput);
    setColour (juce::ComboBox::focusedOutlineColourId,    accent);

    // Popup menu (combo-box dropdown list) -----------------------------------
    setColour (juce::PopupMenu::backgroundColourId,            bgPanel);
    setColour (juce::PopupMenu::textColourId,                  textPrimary);
    setColour (juce::PopupMenu::highlightedBackgroundColourId, accentDim);
    setColour (juce::PopupMenu::highlightedTextColourId,       textPrimary);

    // TextButton --------------------------------------------------------------
    setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId,    bgPanel);
    setColour (juce::TextButton::buttonOnColourId,  accentDim);
    setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOffId,   textPrimary);
    setColour (juce::TextButton::textColourOnId,    textPrimary);

    // Label -------------------------------------------------------------------
    setColour (juce::Label::textColourId,            textPrimary);
    setColour (juce::Label::backgroundColourId,      juce::Colours::transparentBlack);

    // Scrollbar ---------------------------------------------------------------
    setColour (juce::ScrollBar::thumbColourId,       borderStrong);
    setColour (juce::ScrollBar::trackColourId,       bgStrip);
    setColour (juce::ScrollBar::backgroundColourId,  bgWorkspace);

    // Slider text box (we draw the value ourselves inside the rotary, but
    // these stay set in case any other slider in the app needs them) -------
    setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxTextColourId,        textPrimary);
    setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxBackgroundColourId,  juce::Colours::transparentBlack);
    setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxOutlineColourId,     juce::Colours::transparentBlack);
    setColour (juce::Slider::textBoxHighlightColourId,   accentDim);
}

// =============================================================================
// ComboBox
// =============================================================================
void FananLookAndFeel::drawComboBox (juce::Graphics& g, int width, int height,
                                     bool /*isButtonDown*/,
                                     int /*buttonX*/, int /*buttonY*/,
                                     int /*buttonW*/, int /*buttonH*/,
                                     juce::ComboBox& box)
{
    using namespace Theme::Color;

    auto bounds = juce::Rectangle<float> (0.0f, 0.0f, (float) width, (float) height);

    // Pill style: fully rounded ends (radius = half-height). Triggered via a
    // per-component property so individual ComboBoxes can opt in:
    //   combo.getProperties().set ("pillStyle", true);
    const bool pillStyle = (bool) box.getProperties().getWithDefault ("pillStyle", false);
    const float r = pillStyle
                        ? (float) height * 0.5f
                        : juce::jmin (5.0f, (float) height * 0.25f);

    g.setColour (bgInput);
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (bounds, r);

    g.setColour (box.hasKeyboardFocus (false) ? accent : border);
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (bounds.reduced (0.5f), r, 1.0f);

    const float arrowX = (float) width - (float) height * 0.7f;
    const float arrowY = (float) height * 0.5f;
    const float arrowSize = juce::jmin (6.0f, (float) height * 0.25f);

    juce::Path arrow;
    arrow.addTriangle (arrowX - arrowSize, arrowY - arrowSize * 0.4f,
                       arrowX + arrowSize, arrowY - arrowSize * 0.4f,
                       arrowX,             arrowY + arrowSize * 0.6f);
    g.setColour (textSecondary);
    g.fillPath (arrow);
}

void FananLookAndFeel::positionComboBoxText (juce::ComboBox& box, juce::Label& label)
{
    label.setBounds (8, 0,
                     box.getWidth() - (int) ((float) box.getHeight() * 0.9f),
                     box.getHeight());
    label.setFont (getComboBoxFont (box));
    label.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, Theme::Color::textPrimary);
}

juce::Font FananLookAndFeel::getComboBoxFont (juce::ComboBox&)
{
    return Theme::Font::regular (Theme::Font::sizeS);
}

juce::Font FananLookAndFeel::getPopupMenuFont()
{
    return Theme::Font::regular (Theme::Font::sizeM);
}

juce::Font FananLookAndFeel::getLabelFont (juce::Label& l)
{
    if (l.getFont().getHeight() > 1.0f)
        return l.getFont();
    return Theme::Font::regular (Theme::Font::sizeM);
}

void FananLookAndFeel::drawPopupMenuBackground (juce::Graphics& g, int width, int height)
{
    using namespace Theme::Color;
    auto bounds = juce::Rectangle<float> (0.0f, 0.0f, (float) width, (float) height);
    g.setColour (bgPanel);
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (bounds, 4.0f);
    g.setColour (border);
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (bounds.reduced (0.5f), 4.0f, 1.0f);
}

void FananLookAndFeel::drawPopupMenuItem (juce::Graphics& g,
                                          const juce::Rectangle<int>& area,
                                          bool isSeparator, bool /*isActive*/,
                                          bool isHighlighted, bool isTicked,
                                          bool /*hasSubMenu*/,
                                          const juce::String& text,
                                          const juce::String& /*shortcutKeyText*/,
                                          const juce::Drawable* /*icon*/,
                                          const juce::Colour* /*textColour*/)
{
    using namespace Theme::Color;

    if (isSeparator)
    {
        g.setColour (border);
        g.fillRect (area.reduced (8, 0).withSizeKeepingCentre (area.getWidth() - 16, 1));
        return;
    }

    if (isHighlighted)
    {
        g.setColour (accentDim);
        g.fillRoundedRectangle (area.reduced (3, 1).toFloat(), 3.0f);
    }

    g.setColour (textPrimary);
    g.setFont (getPopupMenuFont());

    auto textArea = area.reduced (10, 0);
    if (isTicked)
    {
        g.setColour (accent);
        g.fillEllipse (juce::Rectangle<float> (4.0f, (float) area.getCentreY() - 3.0f, 6.0f, 6.0f));
        textArea = textArea.withTrimmedLeft (6);
    }

    g.setColour (textPrimary);
    g.drawFittedText (text, textArea, juce::Justification::centredLeft, 1);
}

// =============================================================================
// TextButton
// =============================================================================
void FananLookAndFeel::drawButtonBackground (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Button& button,
                                             const juce::Colour& /*backgroundColour*/,
                                             bool isHighlighted, bool isDown)
{
    using namespace Theme::Color;

    auto bounds = button.getLocalBounds().toFloat();
    const float r = juce::jmin (5.0f, bounds.getHeight() * 0.25f);

    auto fill = bgPanel;
    if (button.getToggleState())  fill = accentDim;
    else if (isDown)              fill = bgPanelHi.darker (0.2f);
    else if (isHighlighted)       fill = bgPanelHi;

    g.setColour (fill);
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (bounds, r);

    g.setColour (button.getToggleState() ? accent : border);
    g.drawRoundedRectangle (bounds.reduced (0.5f), r, 1.0f);
}

juce::Font FananLookAndFeel::getTextButtonFont (juce::TextButton&, int /*buttonHeight*/)
{
    return Theme::Font::regular (Theme::Font::sizeM);
}

// =============================================================================
// Scrollbar
// =============================================================================
void FananLookAndFeel::drawScrollbar (juce::Graphics& g, juce::ScrollBar& bar,
                                      int x, int y, int width, int height,
                                      bool isVertical, int thumbStart,
                                      int thumbSize, bool isOver, bool isDown)
{
    using namespace Theme::Color;

    g.setColour (bgStrip);
    g.fillRect (x, y, width, height);

    auto thumb = isVertical
        ? juce::Rectangle<int> (x + 2, thumbStart, width - 4, thumbSize)
        : juce::Rectangle<int> (thumbStart, y + 2, thumbSize, height - 4);

    auto thumbColour = borderStrong;
    if (isDown) thumbColour = accent;
    else if (isOver) thumbColour = borderStrong.brighter (0.2f);

    g.setColour (thumbColour);
    g.fillRoundedRectangle (thumb.toFloat(), 2.0f);

    juce::ignoreUnused (bar);
}

// =============================================================================
// Rotary slider (knob)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Layers, drawn in order:
//   1. PNG background "knob back.png" — fills the full visual bounds.
//   2. Active arc (yellow #E1EC0F) — confined to inner workable radius.
//   3. Indicator line at current angle — same color, slightly inside arc.
//   4. Numeric value (white) — dead center of the rotary; uses the slider's
//      textFromValueFunction so the project-wide 0..100 display convention
//      (see Knob.h) just works.
//
// RADIUS POLICY:
//   - The original Avenger PNG canvas reserved 74% of half-size as the active
//     workable area.
//   - Project spec calls for shrinking that active radius by an additional
//     20%, so the painted arc/indicator are 80% of the prior size while the
//     PNG itself remains unchanged.
//   - Net inner factor = 0.74 * 0.80 = 0.592 of half-size.
// =============================================================================
juce::Image FananLookAndFeel::getKnobBackground()
{
    static const juce::Image cached = []
    {
       #if HAS_BINARY_DATA
        int dataSize = 0;
        if (const char* data = ::BinaryData::getNamedResource ("knob_back_png", dataSize))
            if (dataSize > 0)
                return juce::ImageCache::getFromMemory (data, dataSize);
       #endif
        return juce::Image{};
    }();
    return cached;
}

void FananLookAndFeel::drawRotarySlider (juce::Graphics& g,
                                         int x, int y, int width, int height,
                                         float sliderPos,
                                         float rotaryStart, float rotaryEnd,
                                         juce::Slider& slider)
{
    using namespace Theme::Color;

    const float cx   = (float) x + (float) width  * 0.5f;
    const float cy   = (float) y + (float) height * 0.5f;
    const float size = (float) juce::jmin (width, height);
    const float halfSize = size * 0.5f;

    // -- 1. Background (PNG at full size) --------------------------------------
    if (auto bg = getKnobBackground(); bg.isValid())
    {
        const juce::Rectangle<float> bgArea (cx - halfSize, cy - halfSize, size, size);
        g.drawImage (bg, bgArea, juce::RectanglePlacement::stretchToFit);
    }
    else
    {
        // Fallback so the knob is still visible without the PNG asset
        const float r = halfSize - 1.0f;
        g.setColour (bgPanel);
        g.fillEllipse (cx - r, cy - r, r * 2.0f, r * 2.0f);
        g.setColour (border);
        g.drawEllipse (cx - r, cy - r, r * 2.0f, r * 2.0f, 1.0f);
    }

    // -- 2. Inner workable radius (74% * 80% = 59.2% of half-size) ------------
    const float innerRadius = halfSize * 0.592f;

    // -- 3. Value arc (yellow) ------------------------------------------------
    const float currentAngle = rotaryStart + sliderPos * (rotaryEnd - rotaryStart);
    const bool  bipolar      = (bool) slider.getProperties()
                                            .getWithDefault ("bipolar", false);
    const float arcRadius    = innerRadius - 4.0f;
    const juce::Colour active { knobActiveARGB };

    juce::Path valueArc;
    if (bipolar)
    {
        const float centerAngle = rotaryStart + 0.5f * (rotaryEnd - rotaryStart);
        valueArc.addCentredArc (cx, cy, arcRadius, arcRadius, 0.0f,
                                centerAngle, currentAngle, true);
    }
    else
    {
        valueArc.addCentredArc (cx, cy, arcRadius, arcRadius, 0.0f,
                                rotaryStart, currentAngle, true);
    }

    g.setColour (active);
    g.strokePath (valueArc, juce::PathStrokeType (2.5f,
                                                  juce::PathStrokeType::curved,
                                                  juce::PathStrokeType::rounded));

    // -- 4. Indicator line at current angle -----------------------------------
    const float lineInner = innerRadius * 0.55f;
    const float lineOuter = innerRadius - 2.0f;

    const float sinA = std::sin (currentAngle);
    const float cosA = std::cos (currentAngle);
    const float ix = cx + sinA * lineInner;
    const float iy = cy - cosA * lineInner;
    const float ox = cx + sinA * lineOuter;
    const float oy = cy - cosA * lineOuter;

    g.setColour (active);
    g.drawLine (ix, iy, ox, oy, 2.5f);

    // -- 5. Value text (white) — dead center of the rotary --------------------
    // Pulls through the slider's textFromValueFunction, so the standard
    // 0..1 -> "0".."100" mapping from Knob.h is honored automatically.
    const auto valueText = slider.getTextFromValue (slider.getValue());
    if (valueText.isNotEmpty())
    {
        const float textHeight = juce::jmax (10.0f, innerRadius * 0.42f);
        const float textWidth  = innerRadius * 1.5f;
        const juce::Rectangle<float> textArea (cx - textWidth * 0.5f,
                                               cy - textHeight * 0.5f,
                                               textWidth, textHeight);

        g.setColour (juce::Colours::white);
        g.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (textHeight, juce::Font::bold)));
        g.drawText (valueText, textArea, juce::Justification::centred, false);
    }
}

// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\FxChain.h
#pragma once
//==============================================================================
//  FxChain.h  -  what happens after the voices are summed.
//
//  ARCHETYPE STAGE  the parts of an instrument that act on everything it
//                   plays at once: the EP's stereo tremolo, the vibraphone
//                   motor, the tonewheel scanner vibrato / chorus and the
//                   pipe organ's tremulant.
//  FX CHAIN         in series, no sends (as in Zax):
//                   rotary -> phaser -> chorus -> delay -> reverb -> EQ ->
//                   width -> volume -> safety limiter.
//==============================================================================
#include "NaturaVoice.h"

namespace natura
{
    /** Short modulated delay with linear read (chorus, vibrato, doppler). */
    struct ModDelay
    {
        std::vector<float> buf;
        int mask = 0, w = 0;
        void prepare (int maxSamples)
        {
            int n = 16;
            while (n < maxSamples + 4) n <<= 1;
            buf.assign ((size_t) n, 0.0f);
            mask = n - 1;
            w = 0;
        }
        void clear() { std::fill (buf.begin(), buf.end(), 0.0f); }
        void write (float x) { buf[(size_t) w] = x; w = (w + 1) & mask; }
        float read (float d) const
        {
            d = dsp::clampv (d, 1.0f, (float) (mask - 2));
            const int   i = (int) d;
            const float f = d - (float) i;
            const float a = buf[(size_t) ((w - i) & mask)], b = buf[(size_t) ((w - i - 1) & mask)];
            return a + f * (b - a);
        }
    };

    //==========================================================================
    class ArchetypeStage
    {
    public:
        void prepare (double sampleRate)
        {
            sr = sampleRate;
            scanL.prepare ((int) (0.01 * sr)); scanR.prepare ((int) (0.01 * sr));
            tremL.prepare ((int) (0.01 * sr)); tremR.prepare ((int) (0.01 * sr));
            ph = 0.0;
        }

        void reset() { scanL.clear(); scanR.clear(); tremL.clear(); tremR.clear(); }

        /** motorState: 0 = as set, 1 = forced on, 2 = forced off.
            vibState:   0 = as set, 1 = forced on, 2 = forced off. */
        void process (const Snapshot& s, int motorState, int vibState, float* L, float* R, int n)
        {
            switch (s.arch)
            {
                case Archetype::TineEP:
                {
                    const float depth = s[P::ep_tremdepth] / 100.0f;
                    if (depth <= 0.001f) return;
                    const double inc = std::max (0.1f, law::lfoRate (s[P::ep_tremrate])) / sr;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                    {
                        const float sv = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * ph);
                        ph += inc; if (ph >= 1.0) ph -= 1.0;
                        L[i] *= 1.0f - depth * (0.5f + 0.5f * sv);
                        R[i] *= 1.0f - depth * (0.5f - 0.5f * sv);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                case Archetype::StruckBar:
                {
                    float depth = s[P::sb_motordepth] / 100.0f;
                    if (motorState == 1) depth = std::max (depth, 0.45f);
                    if (motorState == 2) depth = 0.0f;
                    if (depth <= 0.001f) return;
                    const double inc = std::max (0.1f, law::lfoRate (s[P::sb_motorrate])) / sr;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                    {
                        const float sv = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * ph);
                        const float sv2 = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * ph + 0.6);
                        ph += inc; if (ph >= 1.0) ph -= 1.0;
                        L[i] *= 1.0f - depth * 0.85f * (0.5f + 0.5f * sv);
                        R[i] *= 1.0f - depth * 0.85f * (0.5f + 0.5f * sv2);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                case Archetype::Tonewheel:
                {
                    int mode = (int) s[P::tw_vib];
                    if (vibState == 1 && mode == 0) mode = 6;
                    if (vibState == 2) mode = 0;
                    if (mode == 0) return;
                    static const float depthMs[4] = { 0.0f, 0.22f, 0.45f, 0.9f };
                    const float dms = depthMs[mode > 3 ? mode - 3 : mode];
                    const bool chorus = mode > 3;
                    const double inc = 6.9 / sr;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                    {
                        const float sv = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * ph);
                        ph += inc; if (ph >= 1.0) ph -= 1.0;
                        const float d = (float) ((1.0 + dms * (0.5 + 0.5 * sv)) * 0.001 * sr);
                        scanL.write (L[i]); scanR.write (R[i]);
                        const float wl = scanL.read (d), wr = scanR.read (d);
                        L[i] = chorus ? 0.5f * (L[i] + wl) * 1.3f : wl;
                        R[i] = chorus ? 0.5f * (R[i] + wr) * 1.3f : wr;
                    }
                    return;
                }
                case Archetype::PipeOrgan:
                {
                    const float depth = s[P::po_tremdepth] / 100.0f;
                    if (depth <= 0.001f) return;
                    const double inc = std::max (0.5f, law::lfoRate (s[P::po_tremrate])) / sr;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                    {
                        const float sv = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * ph);
                        ph += inc; if (ph >= 1.0) ph -= 1.0;
                        const float d = (float) ((1.0 + depth * 0.35 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sv)) * 0.001 * sr);
                        tremL.write (L[i]); tremR.write (R[i]);
                        const float a = 1.0f - depth * 0.45f * (0.5f + 0.5f * sv);
                        L[i] = tremL.read (d) * a;
                        R[i] = tremR.read (d) * a;
                    }
                    return;
                }
                default: return;
            }
        }

    private:
        double sr = 48000.0, ph = 0.0;
        ModDelay scanL, scanR, tremL, tremR;
    };

    //==========================================================================
    //  ROTARY SPEAKER: horn and drum with their own inertia, doppler and
    //  amplitude rotation, a tube preamp in front, two mics for stereo.
    //==========================================================================
    class Rotary
    {
    public:
        void prepare (double sampleRate)
        {
            sr = sampleRate;
            hornD.prepare ((int) (0.006 * sr));
            drumD.prepare ((int) (0.006 * sr));
            xLp.lowpass (800.0, 0.707, sr);
            xHp.highpass (800.0, 0.707, sr);
            hornSpeed = 0.83f; drumSpeed = 0.67f;
        }
        void reset() { hornD.clear(); drumD.clear(); xLp.reset(); xHp.reset(); }

        void process (float* L, float* R, int n, bool fast, float drive, float balance, float mix)
        {
            const float hT = fast ? 6.7f : 0.83f, dT = fast ? 5.9f : 0.67f;
            const float hk = (float) (1.0 - std::exp (-1.0 / ((hT > hornSpeed ? 0.7 : 1.1) * sr)));
            const float dk = (float) (1.0 - std::exp (-1.0 / ((dT > drumSpeed ? 3.0 : 4.5) * sr)));
            const float pre = 1.0f + drive * 6.0f, post = 1.0f / std::sqrt (pre);
            const float hornG = std::sqrt (balance) * 1.4f, drumG = std::sqrt (1.0f - balance) * 1.4f;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                hornSpeed += (hT - hornSpeed) * hk;
                drumSpeed += (dT - drumSpeed) * dk;
                hPh += hornSpeed / sr; if (hPh >= 1.0) hPh -= 1.0;
                dPh += drumSpeed / sr; if (dPh >= 1.0) dPh -= 1.0;

                const float dry = 0.5f * (L[i] + R[i]);
                const float x = std::tanh (dry * pre) * post;
                const float lo = xLp.process (x), hi = xHp.process (x);
                hornD.write (hi); drumD.write (lo);

                const float hs = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * hPh), hc = (float) std::cos (dsp::kTwoPi * hPh);
                const float ds = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * dPh), dc = (float) std::cos (dsp::kTwoPi * dPh);
                const float hDel = (float) ((1.6 + 0.65 * hs) * 0.001 * sr);
                const float dDel = (float) ((1.2 + 0.25 * ds) * 0.001 * sr);
                const float h = hornD.read (hDel), d = drumD.read (dDel);

                const float hl = h * (0.75f + 0.25f * hc) * hornG, hr = h * (0.75f - 0.25f * hs) * hornG;
                const float dl = d * (0.85f + 0.15f * dc) * drumG, dr = d * (0.85f - 0.15f * ds) * drumG;
                L[i] = L[i] * (1.0f - mix) + (hl + dl) * mix;
                R[i] = R[i] * (1.0f - mix) + (hr + dr) * mix;
            }
        }

    private:
        double sr = 48000.0, hPh = 0.0, dPh = 0.25;
        float hornSpeed = 0.83f, drumSpeed = 0.67f;
        ModDelay hornD, drumD;
        dsp::Biquad xLp, xHp;
    };

    //==========================================================================
    class Phaser
    {
    public:
        void prepare (double sampleRate) { sr = sampleRate; reset(); }
        void reset() { for (auto& c : st) for (auto& a : c) a = {}; fbL = fbR = 0.0f; }

        void process (float* L, float* R, int n, float rateHz, float depth, float fb, float mix)
        {
            const double inc = std::max (0.02f, rateHz) / sr;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                ph += inc; if (ph >= 1.0) ph -= 1.0;
                for (int c = 0; c < 2; ++c)
                {
                    const float lfo = 0.5f + 0.5f * (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * (ph + c * 0.25));
                    const float hz = 200.0f * std::pow (20.0f, lfo * depth);
                    const float t = (float) std::tan (dsp::kPi * std::min (hz, (float) sr * 0.45f) / sr);
                    const float a = (t - 1.0f) / (t + 1.0f);
                    float* io = c == 0 ? L : R;
                    float& fbS = c == 0 ? fbL : fbR;
                    float y = io[i] + fbS * fb * 0.85f;
                    for (auto& s : st[c]) y = s.process (y, a);
                    fbS = y;
                    io[i] = io[i] * (1.0f - mix * 0.5f) + y * mix * 0.5f;
                }
            }
        }

    private:
        struct AP { float x1 = 0.0f, y1 = 0.0f; float process (float x, float a) { const float y = a * x + x1 - a * y1; x1 = x; y1 = y; return y; } };
        double sr = 48000.0, ph = 0.0;
        AP st[2][6];
        float fbL = 0.0f, fbR = 0.0f;
    };

    //==========================================================================
    class Chorus
    {
    public:
        void prepare (double sampleRate) { sr = sampleRate; dl.prepare ((int) (0.03 * sr)); dr.prepare ((int) (0.03 * sr)); }
        void reset() { dl.clear(); dr.clear(); }

        void process (float* L, float* R, int n, float rateHz, float depth, float mix)
        {
            const double inc = std::max (0.05f, rateHz) / sr;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                ph += inc; if (ph >= 1.0) ph -= 1.0;
                const float s1 = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * ph), s2 = -s1;
                dl.write (L[i]); dr.write (R[i]);
                const float wl = dl.read ((float) ((7.0 + depth * 4.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * s1)) * 0.001 * sr));
                const float wr = dr.read ((float) ((7.0 + depth * 4.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * s2)) * 0.001 * sr));
                L[i] = L[i] * (1.0f - mix * 0.5f) + wl * mix * 0.7f;
                R[i] = R[i] * (1.0f - mix * 0.5f) + wr * mix * 0.7f;
            }
        }

    private:
        double sr = 48000.0, ph = 0.0;
        ModDelay dl, dr;
    };

    //==========================================================================
    class StereoDelay
    {
    public:
        void prepare (double sampleRate) { sr = sampleRate; dl.prepare ((int) (2.1 * sr)); dr.prepare ((int) (2.1 * sr)); }
        void reset() { dl.clear(); dr.clear(); lpL.reset(); lpR.reset(); }

        void process (float* L, float* R, int n, float ms, float fb, float tone, bool pingPong, float mix)
        {
            const float target = (float) (ms * 0.001 * sr);
            lpL.setCutoff (dsp::lerp (1500.0f, 14000.0f, tone), sr);
            lpR.a = lpL.a;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                time += (target - time) * 0.0005f;           // glide, no zipper on changes
                const float yl = dl.read (time), yr = dr.read (time);
                const float fl = lpL.process (yl) * fb, fr = lpR.process (yr) * fb;
                if (pingPong)
                {
                    dl.write (0.5f * (L[i] + R[i]) + fr);
                    dr.write (fl);
                }
                else
                {
                    dl.write (L[i] + fl);
                    dr.write (R[i] + fr);
                }
                L[i] += yl * mix;
                R[i] += yr * mix;
            }
        }

    private:
        double sr = 48000.0;
        float time = 10000.0f;
        ModDelay dl, dr;
        dsp::OnePoleLP lpL, lpR;
    };

    //==========================================================================
    //  8-line feedback delay network reverb with input diffusion, damping and
    //  pre-delay.
    //==========================================================================
    class Reverb
    {
    public:
        void prepare (double sampleRate)
        {
            sr = sampleRate;
            const double scale = sr / 48000.0;
            static const int baseLen[8] = { 1557, 1617, 1491, 1422, 1277, 1356, 1188, 1116 };
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
            {
                lines[i].prepare ((int) (baseLen[i] * scale * 2.2) + 8);
                len[i] = (float) (baseLen[i] * scale);
            }
            static const int apLen[4] = { 142, 107, 379, 277 };
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) { diff[i].prepare ((int) (apLen[i] * scale) + 4); diffLen[i] = (int) (apLen[i] * scale); }
            pre.prepare ((int) (0.25 * sr));
            reset();
        }

        void reset()
        {
            for (auto& l : lines) l.clear();
            for (auto& d : diff) d.clear();
            pre.clear();
            for (auto& d : damp) d.reset();
        }

        void process (float* L, float* R, int n, float size, float dampAmt, float preDelay, float mix)
        {
            const float rt60 = dsp::lerp (0.5f, 7.0f, size * size);
            const float lscale = dsp::lerp (0.55f, 1.6f, size);
            float g[8], d[8];
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
            {
                d[i] = len[i] * lscale;
                g[i] = (float) std::pow (10.0, -3.0 * d[i] / (rt60 * sr));
                damp[i].setCutoff (dsp::lerp (14000.0f, 1800.0f, dampAmt), sr);
            }
            const float preS = (float) (preDelay * 0.2 * sr) + 1.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                modPh += 0.37 / sr; if (modPh >= 1.0) modPh -= 1.0;
                const float mod = (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * modPh) * 6.0f;

                pre.write (0.5f * (L[i] + R[i]));
                float x = pre.read (preS);
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k)
                {
                    const float delayed = diff[k].read ((float) diffLen[k]);
                    const float v = x + 0.6f * delayed;
                    diff[k].write (v);
                    x = delayed - 0.6f * v;
                }

                float o[8];
                for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k)
                    o[k] = damp[k].process (lines[k].read (d[k] + (k < 2 ? (k == 0 ? mod : -mod) : 0.0f))) * g[k];

                // Hadamard-style mixing (orthogonal, energy preserving)
                float a[8];
                for (int k = 0; k < 8; k += 2) { a[k] = o[k] + o[k + 1]; a[k + 1] = o[k] - o[k + 1]; }
                float b[8];
                for (int k = 0; k < 8; k += 4)
                    for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j) { b[k + j] = a[k + j] + a[k + j + 2]; b[k + j + 2] = a[k + j] - a[k + j + 2]; }
                float c[8];
                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) { c[j] = b[j] + b[j + 4]; c[j + 4] = b[j] - b[j + 4]; }
                const float norm = 0.35355339f;
                for (int k = 0; k < 8; ++k) lines[k].write (c[k] * norm + (k % 2 == 0 ? x : -x) * 0.5f);

                const float wl = (o[0] + o[2] + o[4] + o[6]) * 0.5f;
                const float wr = (o[1] + o[3] + o[5] + o[7]) * 0.5f;
                L[i] = L[i] * (1.0f - mix * 0.5f) + wl * mix;
                R[i] = R[i] * (1.0f - mix * 0.5f) + wr * mix;
            }
        }

    private:
        double sr = 48000.0, modPh = 0.0;
        ModDelay lines[8], diff[4], pre;
        float len[8] = {};
        int   diffLen[4] = {};
        dsp::OnePoleLP damp[8];
    };

    //==========================================================================
    class FxChain
    {
    public:
        void prepare (double sampleRate)
        {
            sr = sampleRate;
            stage.prepare (sr); rotary.prepare (sr); phaser.prepare (sr); chorus.prepare (sr);
            delay.prepare (sr); reverb.prepare (sr);
            reset();
        }

        void reset()
        {
            stage.reset(); rotary.reset(); phaser.reset(); chorus.reset(); delay.reset(); reverb.reset();
            for (auto& e : eqLo) e.reset();
            for (auto& e : eqHi) e.reset();
        }

        void process (const Snapshot& s, bool rotorFast, int motorState, int vibState, float* L, float* R, int n)
        {
            stage.process (s, motorState, vibState, L, R, n);

            if (s[P::rot_on] >= 0.5f)
                rotary.process (L, R, n, rotorFast, s[P::rot_drive] / 100.0f, s[P::rot_balance] / 100.0f, s[P::rot_mix] / 100.0f);
            if (s[P::pha_on] >= 0.5f)
                phaser.process (L, R, n, law::lfoRate (s[P::pha_rate]), s[P::pha_depth] / 100.0f, s[P::pha_fb] / 100.0f, s[P::pha_mix] / 100.0f);
            if (s[P::cho_on] >= 0.5f)
                chorus.process (L, R, n, law::lfoRate (s[P::cho_rate]), s[P::cho_depth] / 100.0f, s[P::cho_mix] / 100.0f);
            if (s[P::dly_on] >= 0.5f)
                delay.process (L, R, n, law::delayMs (s[P::dly_time]), s[P::dly_fb] / 100.0f * 0.92f, s[P::dly_tone] / 100.0f,
                               s[P::dly_pingpong] >= 0.5f, s[P::dly_mix] / 100.0f);
            if (s[P::rev_on] >= 0.5f)
                reverb.process (L, R, n, s[P::rev_size] / 100.0f, s[P::rev_damp] / 100.0f, s[P::rev_predelay] / 100.0f, s[P::rev_mix] / 100.0f);

            const float lo = s[P::eq_low], hi = s[P::eq_high];
            const bool eqOn = std::abs (lo) > 0.05f || std::abs (hi) > 0.05f;
            if (eqOn && (lo != lastLo || hi != lastHi))
            {
                lastLo = lo; lastHi = hi;
                for (auto& e : eqLo) e.lowShelf (120.0, lo, sr);
                for (auto& e : eqHi) e.highShelf (6000.0, hi, sr);
            }
            const float width = s[P::out_width] / 100.0f;
            const float vol = dsp::dbToGain (s[P::out_volume]);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            {
                float l = L[i], r = R[i];
                if (eqOn) { l = eqHi[0].process (eqLo[0].process (l)); r = eqHi[1].process (eqLo[1].process (r)); }
                const float m = 0.5f * (l + r), sd = 0.5f * (l - r) * width;
                l = (m + sd) * vol; r = (m - sd) * vol;
                // safety: a soft knee above -1 dBFS, never a hard clip
                L[i] = std::abs (l) < 0.89f ? l : std::copysign (0.89f + 0.11f * std::tanh ((std::abs (l) - 0.89f) / 0.11f), l);
                R[i] = std::abs (r) < 0.89f ? r : std::copysign (0.89f + 0.11f * std::tanh ((std::abs (r) - 0.89f) / 0.11f), r);
            }
        }

    private:
        double sr = 48000.0;
        ArchetypeStage stage;
        Rotary rotary;
        Phaser phaser;
        Chorus chorus;
        StereoDelay delay;
        Reverb reverb;
        dsp::Biquad eqLo[2], eqHi[2];
        float lastLo = 1000.0f, lastHi = 1000.0f;
    };
}
