NaturaKeyboard::NaturaKeyboard (NaturaProcessor& p)
    : juce::MidiKeyboardComponent (p.keyboardState, juce::MidiKeyboardComponent::horizontalKeyboard), proc (p)
{
    setAvailableRange (21, 108);
    setOctaveForMiddleC (3);
    setScrollButtonsVisible (false);
    setColour (whiteNoteColourId, juce::Colour (0xFFE8E8EE));
    setColour (blackNoteColourId, juce::Colour (0xFF16161C));
    setColour (keyDownOverlayColourId, juce::Colour (Theme::Gold::kAccent).withAlpha (0.75f));
    setColour (mouseOverKeyOverlayColourId, juce::Colour (Theme::Gold::kAccentLight).withAlpha (0.25f));
}

void NaturaKeyboard::update()
{
    const bool on = proc.value (P::art_ks_on) >= 0.5f;
    const int base = (int) proc.value (P::art_ks_base);
    const int count = artsFor ((Archetype) (int) proc.value (P::archetype)).count;
    const int active = proc.engine.currentArt.load();
    if (on != ksOn || base != ksBase || count != ksCount || active != ksActive)
    {
        ksOn = on; ksBase = base; ksCount = count; ksActive = active;
        repaint();
    }
}

int NaturaKeyboard::ksState (int note) const
{
    if (! ksOn || note < ksBase || note >= ksBase + ksCount) return 0;
    return note - ksBase == ksActive ? 2 : 1;
}

void NaturaKeyboard::drawWhiteNote (int note, juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area,
                                    bool isDown, bool isOver, juce::Colour lineColour, juce::Colour textColour)
{
    juce::MidiKeyboardComponent::drawWhiteNote (note, g, area, isDown, isOver, lineColour, textColour);
    if (const int st = ksState (note))
    {
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (Theme::Gold::kAccent).withAlpha (st == 2 ? 0.85f : 0.35f));
        g.fillRect (area.reduced (1.0f, 0.0f).withTrimmedTop (area.getHeight() * 0.45f));
    }
}

void NaturaKeyboard::drawBlackNote (int note, juce::Graphics& g, juce::Rectangle<float> area,
                                    bool isDown, bool isOver, juce::Colour noteFillColour)
{
    juce::MidiKeyboardComponent::drawBlackNote (note, g, area, isDown, isOver, noteFillColour);
    if (const int st = ksState (note))
    {
        g.setColour (juce::Colour (Theme::Gold::kAccent).withAlpha (st == 2 ? 0.95f : 0.5f));
        g.fillRect (area.reduced (2.0f).withTrimmedTop (area.getHeight() * 0.5f));
    }
}

//==============================================================================
//  EDITOR
//==============================================================================
NaturaEditor::NaturaEditor (NaturaProcessor& p) : AudioProcessorEditor (&p), proc (p)
{
    setLookAndFeel (&laf);

    for (int a = 0; a < kNumArchetypes; ++a) archetypeBox.addItem (archetypeName (a), a + 1);
    archetypeBox.setSelectedId ((int) proc.value (P::archetype) + 1, juce::dontSendNotification);
    archetypeBox.getProperties().set ("pillStyle", true);
    archetypeBox.onChange = [this]
    {
        const int a = archetypeBox.getSelectedId() - 1;
        if (a >= 0 && a != (int) proc.value (P::archetype))
        {
            proc.loadArchetypeRoot (a);
            presetCursor = -1;
        }
    };
    addAndMakeVisible (archetypeBox);

    presetName.onClick = [this] { showPresetMenu(); };
    prevBtn.onClick = [this] { stepPreset (-1); };
    nextBtn.onClick = [this] { stepPreset (1); };
    loadBtn.onClick = [this] { loadPreset(); };
    saveBtn.onClick = [this] { savePresetAs(); };
    quickBtn.onClick = [this] { quickSave(); };
    for (auto* b : { &presetName, &prevBtn, &nextBtn, &loadBtn, &saveBtn, &quickBtn }) addAndMakeVisible (b);

    status.setJustificationType (juce::Justification::centredRight);
    status.setColour (juce::Label::textColourId, juce::Colour (Theme::Gold::kAccentLight));
    status.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (13.0f, juce::Font::bold)));
    addAndMakeVisible (status);

    const char* names[5] = { "MODEL", "ARTIC", "SYNTHESIS", "MODULATION", "FX" };
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
    {
        tabs[i].setButtonText (names[i]);
        tabs[i].onClick = [this, i] { showTab (i); };
        addAndMakeVisible (tabs[i]);
    }

    model      = std::make_unique<ModelPage> (proc);
    artic      = std::make_unique<ArticPage> (proc);
    synthesis  = std::make_unique<SynthesisPage> (proc);
    modulation = std::make_unique<ModulationPage> (proc);
    fxPage     = std::make_unique<FxPage> (proc);
    for (juce::Component* c : { (juce::Component*) model.get(), (juce::Component*) artic.get(), (juce::Component*) synthesis.get(),
                                (juce::Component*) modulation.get(), (juce::Component*) fxPage.get() })
        addChildComponent (c);

    keyboard = std::make_unique<NaturaKeyboard> (proc);
    addAndMakeVisible (*keyboard);

    setSize (Theme::Natura::width, Theme::Natura::height);
    showTab (0);
    refreshPresetLabel();
    startTimerHz (15);
}

NaturaEditor::~NaturaEditor()
{
    stopTimer();
    setLookAndFeel (nullptr);
}

void NaturaEditor::showTab (int index)
{
    currentTab = index;
    juce::Component* pages[5] = { model.get(), artic.get(), synthesis.get(), modulation.get(), fxPage.get() };
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)
    {
        pages[i]->setVisible (i == index);
        InstrEditStyle::styleSquareButton (tabs[i], i == index);
    }
}

void NaturaEditor::paint (juce::Graphics& g)
{
    using namespace Theme::Color;
    g.fillAll (bgPage);
    g.setColour (bgStrip);
    g.fillRect (0, 0, getWidth(), 56);
    g.setColour (border);
    g.drawHorizontalLine (56, 0.0f, (float) getWidth());

    g.setColour (juce::Colour (Theme::Gold::kAccent));
    g.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (30.0f, juce::Font::bold)));
    g.drawText ("NATURA", 18, 6, 170, 44, juce::Justification::centredLeft);
    g.setColour (textSecondary);
    g.setFont (juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (11.0f)));
    g.drawText ("by FANAN", 152, 26, 80, 20, juce::Justification::centredLeft);
}

void NaturaEditor::resized()
{
    auto r = getLocalBounds();
    auto top = r.removeFromTop (56).reduced (12, 10);
    top.removeFromLeft (220);
    archetypeBox.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (230));
    top.removeFromLeft (16);
    prevBtn.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (32));
    top.removeFromLeft (4);
    presetName.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (260));
    top.removeFromLeft (4);
    nextBtn.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (32));
    top.removeFromLeft (12);
    loadBtn.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (70));
    top.removeFromLeft (6);
    saveBtn.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (70));
    top.removeFromLeft (6);
    quickBtn.setBounds (top.removeFromLeft (110));
    status.setBounds (top.reduced (8, 0));

    auto tabRow = r.removeFromTop (40).reduced (12, 6);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) { tabs[i].setBounds (tabRow.removeFromLeft (130)); tabRow.removeFromLeft (8); }

    keyboard->setBounds (r.removeFromBottom (84).reduced (12, 6));
    const float keyW = (float) keyboard->getWidth() / 52.0f;   // 52 white keys from A-1 to C7
    keyboard->setKeyWidth (keyW);

    for (juce::Component* c : { (juce::Component*) model.get(), (juce::Component*) artic.get(), (juce::Component*) synthesis.get(),
                                (juce::Component*) modulation.get(), (juce::Component*) fxPage.get() })
        c->setBounds (r);
}

void NaturaEditor::timerCallback()
{
    const int a = (int) proc.value (P::archetype);
    if (a != shownArch)
    {
        shownArch = a;
        archetypeBox.setSelectedId (a + 1, juce::dontSendNotification);
        model->setArchetype (a);
        artic->setArchetype (a);
    }
    refreshPresetLabel();
    keyboard->update();

    const int art = proc.engine.currentArt.load();
    const juce::String txt = juce::String (artName (artAt ((Archetype) a, art))) + "   |   "
                           + juce::String (proc.engine.activeVoices.load()) + " VOICES";
    if (status.getText() != txt) status.setText (txt, juce::dontSendNotification);
}

void NaturaEditor::refreshPresetLabel()
{
    const auto name = proc.presetName + (proc.presetFile != juce::File() ? "" : "");
    if (name != shownPreset) { shownPreset = name; presetName.setButtonText (name); }
}

//==============================================================================
//  PRESETS
//==============================================================================
void NaturaEditor::showPresetMenu()
{
    juce::PopupMenu menu;
    const auto& fac = factoryPresets();
    const int arch = (int) proc.value (P::archetype);

    menu.addSectionHeader ("ROOT MODELS");
    juce::PopupMenu roots;
    for (int a = 0; a < kNumArchetypes; ++a) roots.addItem (1000 + a, archetypeName (a), true, a == arch);
    menu.addSubMenu ("Load a root model", roots);

    menu.addSectionHeader ("FACTORY");
    for (int a = 0; a < kNumArchetypes; ++a)
    {
        juce::PopupMenu sub;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int) fac.size(); ++i)
            if ((int) fac[(size_t) i].arch == a)
                sub.addItem (1 + i, fac[(size_t) i].name, true, proc.presetName == fac[(size_t) i].name && proc.presetFile == juce::File());
        menu.addSubMenu (archetypeName (a), sub);
    }

    const auto user = PresetManager::userPresets();
    menu.addSectionHeader ("MY PRESETS");
    if (user.isEmpty()) menu.addItem (-1, "(none saved yet)", false);
    for (int i = 0; i < user.size(); ++i)
        menu.addItem (5000 + i, user[i].getFileNameWithoutExtension(), true, user[i] == proc.presetFile);
    menu.addSeparator();
    menu.addItem (9000, "Show presets folder");

    menu.showMenuAsync (juce::PopupMenu::Options().withTargetComponent (&presetName),
        [this, user] (int r)
        {
            if (r <= 0) return;
            if (r >= 1000 && r < 1000 + kNumArchetypes) { proc.loadArchetypeRoot (r - 1000); presetCursor = -1; }
            else if (r >= 1 && r <= (int) factoryPresets().size()) { proc.loadFactory (r - 1); presetCursor = r - 1; }
            else if (r >= 5000 && r < 5000 + user.size()) { proc.loadPresetFile (user[r - 5000]); presetCursor = (int) factoryPresets().size() + (r - 5000); }
            else if (r == 9000) { PresetManager::folder().createDirectory(); PresetManager::folder().startAsProcess(); }
            refreshPresetLabel();
        });
}

void NaturaEditor::stepPreset (int delta)
{
    const auto& fac = factoryPresets();
    const auto user = PresetManager::userPresets();
    const int total = (int) fac.size() + user.size();
    if (total == 0) return;
    if (presetCursor < 0)
    {
        presetCursor = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int) fac.size(); ++i) if (proc.presetName == juce::String (fac[(size_t) i].name)) presetCursor = i;
        for (int i = 0; i < user.size(); ++i) if (user[i] == proc.presetFile) presetCursor = (int) fac.size() + i;
        if (delta > 0) presetCursor -= 1;
    }
    presetCursor = ((presetCursor + delta) % total + total) % total;
    if (presetCursor < (int) fac.size()) proc.loadFactory (presetCursor);
    else proc.loadPresetFile (user[presetCursor - (int) fac.size()]);
    refreshPresetLabel();
}

void NaturaEditor::loadPreset()
{
    PresetManager::folder().createDirectory();
    chooser = std::make_unique<juce::FileChooser> ("Load a Natura preset", PresetManager::folder(), juce::String ("*") + PresetManager::extension);
    chooser->launchAsync (juce::FileBrowserComponent::openMode | juce::FileBrowserComponent::canSelectFiles,
        [this] (const juce::FileChooser& fc)
        {
            const auto f = fc.getResult();
            if (f.existsAsFile() && ! proc.loadPresetFile (f))
                juce::AlertWindow::showMessageBoxAsync (juce::MessageBoxIconType::WarningIcon, "Natura", "That file is not a Natura preset.");
            presetCursor = -1;
            refreshPresetLabel();
        });
}

void NaturaEditor::savePresetAs()
{
    auto* w = new juce::AlertWindow ("Save preset", "Name for this sound:", juce::MessageBoxIconType::NoIcon);
    w->addTextEditor ("name", proc.presetName.replace (" (root)", ""));
    w->addButton ("SAVE", 1, juce::KeyPress (juce::KeyPress::returnKey));
    w->addButton ("CANCEL", 0, juce::KeyPress (juce::KeyPress::escapeKey));
    w->setLookAndFeel (&laf);
    juce::Component::SafePointer<NaturaEditor> safe (this);
    w->enterModalState (true, juce::ModalCallbackFunction::create ([safe, w] (int r)
    {
        if (safe != nullptr && r == 1)
        {
            const auto name = PresetManager::cleanName (w->getTextEditorContents ("name"));
            const auto file = PresetManager::folder().getChildFile (name + PresetManager::extension);
            const auto res = safe->proc.savePresetFile (file, name);
            if (res.failed())
                juce::AlertWindow::showMessageBoxAsync (juce::MessageBoxIconType::WarningIcon, "Natura", res.getErrorMessage());
            safe->presetCursor = -1;
            safe->refreshPresetLabel();
        }
    }), true);
}

void NaturaEditor::quickSave()
{
    if (proc.presetFile != juce::File())
    {
        const auto res = proc.savePresetFile (proc.presetFile, proc.presetName);
        if (res.failed())
            juce::AlertWindow::showMessageBoxAsync (juce::MessageBoxIconType::WarningIcon, "Natura", res.getErrorMessage());
        return;
    }
    savePresetAs();   // factory and root sounds are never overwritten
}

// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\PluginEditor.h
#pragma once
//==============================================================================
//  PluginEditor.h  -  the panel: archetype selector and presets on top,
//  MODEL / ARTIC / SYNTHESIS / MODULATION / FX tabs, the keyboard below
//  (keyswitch keys lit in gold).

    /** Bambino's look, plus Grex's square buttons: a button whose colours were
        set (InstrEditStyle::styleSquareButton) is drawn in those colours. */
    class NaturaLookAndFeel final : public FananLookAndFeel
    {
    public:
        void drawButtonBackground (juce::Graphics& g, juce::Button& b, const juce::Colour& bg,
                                   bool highlighted, bool down) override
        {
            if (! b.isColourSpecified (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId))
            {
                FananLookAndFeel::drawButtonBackground (g, b, bg, highlighted, down);
                return;
            }
            const bool on = b.findColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId) == juce::Colour (Theme::Gold::kAccent);
            auto r = b.getLocalBounds().toFloat().reduced (0.5f);
            const float rad = juce::jmin (5.0f, r.getHeight() * 0.25f);
            auto fill = b.findColour (juce::TextButton::buttonColourId);
            if (! on && (highlighted || down)) fill = fill.brighter (down ? 0.05f : 0.15f);
            g.setColour (fill);
            g.fillRoundedRectangle (r, rad);
            g.setColour (on ? juce::Colour (Theme::Gold::kAccentLight) : Theme::Color::border);
            g.drawRoundedRectangle (r, rad, 1.0f);
        }
    };

// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\PluginProcessor.cpp
#include "PluginProcessor.h"
#include "PluginEditor.h"

using namespace natura;

NaturaProcessor::NaturaProcessor()
    : AudioProcessor (BusesProperties().withOutput ("Output", juce::AudioChannelSet::stereo(), true)),
      apvts (*this, nullptr, "NATURA", createLayout())
{
    for (int i = 0; i < kNumParams; ++i)
    {
        raw[(size_t) i]    = apvts.getRawParameterValue (info (i).id);
        params[(size_t) i] = apvts.getParameter (info (i).id);
        jassert (raw[(size_t) i] != nullptr && params[(size_t) i] != nullptr);
    }
    // a new instance opens on the first factory sound
    applyValues (factoryValues (factoryPresets().front()));
    presetName = factoryPresets().front().name;
}

bool NaturaProcessor::isBusesLayoutSupported (const BusesLayout& layouts) const
{
    const auto out = layouts.getMainOutputChannelSet();
    return out == juce::AudioChannelSet::stereo() || out == juce::AudioChannelSet::mono();
}

void NaturaProcessor::prepareToPlay (double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock)
{
    engine.prepare (sampleRate, samplesPerBlock);
    keyboardState.reset();
}

void NaturaProcessor::processBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>& buffer, juce::MidiBuffer& midi)
{
    juce::ScopedNoDenormals noDenormals;
    keyboardState.processNextMidiBuffer (midi, 0, buffer.getNumSamples(), true);
    for (int i = 0; i < kNumParams; ++i) values[(size_t) i] = raw[(size_t) i]->load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
    engine.process (buffer, midi, values.data());
}

juce::AudioProcessorEditor* NaturaProcessor::createEditor()
{
    return new NaturaEditor (*this);
}

//==============================================================================
void NaturaProcessor::getStateInformation (juce::MemoryBlock& destData)
{
    auto state = apvts.copyState();
    state.setProperty ("presetName", presetName, nullptr);
    state.setProperty ("presetFile", presetFile.getFullPathName(), nullptr);
    if (auto xml = state.createXml())
        copyXmlToBinary (*xml, destData);
}

void NaturaProcessor::setStateInformation (const void* data, int sizeInBytes)
{
    if (auto xml = getXmlFromBinary (data, sizeInBytes))
        if (xml->hasTagName (apvts.state.getType()))
        {
            auto state = juce::ValueTree::fromXml (*xml);
            presetName = state.getProperty ("presetName", presetName).toString();
            const auto path = state.getProperty ("presetFile", "").toString();
            presetFile = path.isNotEmpty() && juce::File::isAbsolutePath (path) ? juce::File (path) : juce::File();
            apvts.replaceState (state);
        }
}

//==============================================================================
std::vector<float> NaturaProcessor::currentValues() const
{
    std::vector<float> v ((size_t) kNumParams);
    for (int i = 0; i < kNumParams; ++i) v[(size_t) i] = raw[(size_t) i]->load();
    return v;
}

void NaturaProcessor::applyValues (const std::vector<float>& v)
{
    // archetype first: the engine resets its instrument before the rest arrives
    auto set = [this, &v] (int i)
    {
        auto* p = params[(size_t) i];
        p->beginChangeGesture();
        p->setValueNotifyingHost (p->convertTo0to1 (v[(size_t) i]));
        p->endChangeGesture();
    };
    set ((int) P::archetype);
    for (int i = 0; i < kNumParams; ++i)
        if (i != (int) P::archetype) set (i);
}

void NaturaProcessor::loadArchetypeRoot (int archetype)
{
    auto v = rootValues ((Archetype) juce::jlimit (0, kNumArchetypes - 1, archetype));
    v[(size_t) P::out_volume] = value (P::out_volume);
    applyValues (v);
    presetName = juce::String (archetypeName (archetype)) + " (root)";
    presetFile = juce::File();
}

void NaturaProcessor::loadFactory (int index)
{
    const auto& list = factoryPresets();
    if (! juce::isPositiveAndBelow (index, (int) list.size())) return;
    auto v = factoryValues (list[(size_t) index]);
    v[(size_t) P::out_volume] = value (P::out_volume);
    applyValues (v);
    presetName = list[(size_t) index].name;
    presetFile = juce::File();
}

bool NaturaProcessor::loadPresetFile (const juce::File& file)
{
    auto loaded = PresetManager::load (file);
    if (! loaded) return false;
    applyValues (loaded->values);
    presetName = loaded->name;
    presetFile = file;
    return true;
}

juce::Result NaturaProcessor::savePresetFile (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& name)
{
    const auto r = PresetManager::save (file, name, currentValues());
    if (r.wasOk()) { presetName = name; presetFile = file; }
    return r;
}

void NaturaProcessor::requestArticulation (int index)
{
    auto* p = params[(size_t) P::art_select];
    p->beginChangeGesture();
    p->setValueNotifyingHost (p->convertTo0to1 ((float) index));
    p->endChangeGesture();
    engine.forcedArt.store (index);
}

//==============================================================================
juce::AudioProcessor* JUCE_CALLTYPE createPluginFilter()
{
    return new NaturaProcessor();
}

#pragma once
//==============================================================================
//  PluginProcessor.h  -  Natura, the Sonify modeling synth.
//==============================================================================
#include <JuceHeader.h>
#include "NaturaEngine.h"
#include "PresetManager.h"

class NaturaProcessor final : public juce::AudioProcessor
{
public:
    NaturaProcessor();
    ~NaturaProcessor() override = default;

    void prepareToPlay (double sampleRate, int samplesPerBlock) override;
    void releaseResources() override {}
    bool isBusesLayoutSupported (const BusesLayout& layouts) const override;
    void processBlock (juce::AudioBuffer<float>&, juce::MidiBuffer&) override;

    juce::AudioProcessorEditor* createEditor() override;
    bool hasEditor() const override { return true; }

    const juce::String getName() const override { return "Natura"; }
    bool acceptsMidi() const override  { return true; }
    bool producesMidi() const override { return false; }
    bool isMidiEffect() const override { return false; }
    double getTailLengthSeconds() const override { return 8.0; }

    int getNumPrograms() override    { return 1; }
    int getCurrentProgram() override { return 0; }
    void setCurrentProgram (int) override {}
    const juce::String getProgramName (int) override { return presetName; }
    void changeProgramName (int, const juce::String&) override {}

    void getStateInformation (juce::MemoryBlock& destData) override;
    void setStateInformation (const void* data, int sizeInBytes) override;

    //==========================================================================
    // presets and roots (message thread)
    void applyValues (const std::vector<float>& values);
    std::vector<float> currentValues() const;
    void loadArchetypeRoot (int archetype);
    void loadFactory (int index);
    bool loadPresetFile (const juce::File& file);
    juce::Result savePresetFile (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& name);

    /** The panel picked an articulation: honoured even when the parameter
        already holds that index (a keyswitch may have moved off it). */
    void requestArticulation (int index);

    float value (natura::P p) const { return raw[(int) p]->load(); }
    juce::RangedAudioParameter* param (natura::P p) const { return params[(size_t) p]; }

    juce::AudioProcessorValueTreeState apvts;
    juce::MidiKeyboardState keyboardState;
    natura::NaturaEngine engine;

    juce::String presetName { "Grand Piano" };
    juce::File   presetFile;                 // empty: not one of the user's files

private:
    std::array<std::atomic<float>*, natura::kNumParams> raw {};
    std::array<juce::RangedAudioParameter*, natura::kNumParams> params {};
    std::array<float, natura::kNumParams> values {};

    JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR (NaturaProcessor)
};

// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\PresetManager.h
#pragma once
//==============================================================================
//  PresetManager.h  -  Natura presets in Sonify's own preset format.
//
//  A preset is one .sonifypreset file in
//      %APPDATA%\Fanan\Sonify\Presets\Natura\<name>.sonifypreset
//  holding {"format":"Sonify preset","formatVersion":1,"plugin":"Natura",
//  "name":..., "values":{ "<parameter id>": value, ... }} - the same file
//  Sonify's own preset manager reads, so a preset saved here shows there.
//
//  Loading starts from the preset's archetype root and lays the stored values
//  over it, so a preset from an older Natura (fewer parameters) still loads
//  as it was meant to sound.
//==============================================================================
#include "Archetypes.h"

namespace natura
{
    struct PresetManager
    {
        static constexpr const char* extension = ".sonifypreset";

        static juce::File folder()
        {
            return juce::File::getSpecialLocation (juce::File::userApplicationDataDirectory)
                       .getChildFile ("Fanan").getChildFile ("Sonify").getChildFile ("Presets").getChildFile ("Natura");
        }

        static juce::String cleanName (juce::String n)
        {
            n = n.trim();
            n = n.removeCharacters ("\\/:*?\"<>|");
            return n.isEmpty() ? juce::String ("Untitled") : n;
        }

        static juce::Result save (const juce::File& file, const juce::String& name, const std::vector<float>& values)
        {
            auto* valuesObj = new juce::DynamicObject();
            for (int i = 0; i < kNumParams; ++i)
                valuesObj->setProperty (info (i).id, values[(size_t) i]);

            auto* root = new juce::DynamicObject();
            root->setProperty ("format", "Sonify preset");
            root->setProperty ("formatVersion", 1);
            root->setProperty ("plugin", "Natura");
            root->setProperty ("name", name);
            root->setProperty ("values", juce::var (valuesObj));

            if (! file.getParentDirectory().createDirectory())
                return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't make the folder " + file.getParentDirectory().getFullPathName());
            if (! file.replaceWithText (juce::JSON::toString (juce::var (root))))
                return juce::Result::fail ("Couldn't write " + file.getFullPathName());
            return juce::Result::ok();
        }

        struct Loaded { juce::String name; std::vector<float> values; };

        static std::optional<Loaded> load (const juce::File& file)
        {
            const auto json = juce::JSON::parse (file.loadFileAsString());
            auto* values = json.getProperty ("values", {}).getDynamicObject();
            if (values == nullptr) return std::nullopt;

            int arch = 0;
            if (values->hasProperty ("archetype"))
                arch = juce::jlimit (0, kNumArchetypes - 1, (int) values->getProperty ("archetype"));

            Loaded out;
            out.values = rootValues ((Archetype) arch);
            for (const auto& prop : values->getProperties())
            {
                const int idx = findParam (prop.name.toString());
                if (idx < 0) continue;
                const auto& in = info (idx);
                out.values[(size_t) idx] = juce::jlimit (in.minV, in.maxV, (float) (double) prop.value);
            }
            out.name = json.getProperty ("name", file.getFileNameWithoutExtension()).toString();
            if (out.name.isEmpty()) out.name = file.getFileNameWithoutExtension();
            return out;
        }

        static juce::Array<juce::File> userPresets()
        {
            auto files = folder().findChildFiles (juce::File::findFiles, false, juce::String ("*") + extension);
            files.sort();
            return files;
        }
    };
}

// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\SynthCommon.h
#pragma once
//==============================================================================
//  SynthCommon.h  -  the synthesis department every voice runs after its
//  model: Grex's AHDSR (one signed curve for decay and release), the TPT
//  state-variable filter, LFOs with pre-delay, the body resonator and the
//  character stage.
//==============================================================================
#include "ModelDsp.h"

namespace natura
{
    //==========================================================================
    //  AHDSR - from Grex.  Attack overshoots towards 1.5 for punch and reaches
    //  full level in exactly the labelled time; decay and release run an exact
    //  phase through one signed curve, so every shape takes the labelled time
    //  and only the contour changes:  k > 0 front-loaded (EXP, TIGHT),
    //  k = 0 linear, k < 0 holds then falls (LOG, SWELL).
    //==========================================================================
    struct AHDSREnvelope
    {
        enum Stage { Idle, Attack, Hold, Decay, Sustain, Release };
        Stage stage = Idle;
        float curveK = 6.0f, level = 0.0f;
        float attackCoeff = 1.0f, sustainLevel = 0.0f, holdSamples = 0.0f;
        int   holdCounter = 0;
        float segStart = 0.0f, segEnd = 0.0f;
        double segPhase = 0.0, segInc = 0.0;
        float decayInc = 0.0f;

        static constexpr float kAttackTarget = 1.5f;
        static constexpr float kAttackScale  = 1.0f / 1.0986f;   // ln(1.5/0.5)

        static float msToCoeff (float ms, double sr)
        {
            if (ms < 0.1f) return 1.0f;
            return 1.0f - std::exp (-1.0f / ((float) ms * 0.001f * (float) sr));
        }

        static float fallAmount (float p, float k)
        {
            p = dsp::clampv (p, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            if (std::abs (k) < 1.0e-3f) return p;
            return (1.0f - std::exp (-k * p)) / (1.0f - std::exp (-k));
        }

        void noteOn (float attackMs, float holdMs, float decayMs, float sustain, double sr, bool fromCurrent = true)
        {
            if (! fromCurrent) level = 0.0f;
            sustainLevel = sustain;
            attackCoeff  = msToCoeff (attackMs * kAttackScale, sr);
            const double decaySamples = decayMs * 0.001 * sr;
            decayInc = (decayMs < 0.1f || decaySamples < 1.0) ? 1.0e9f : (float) (1.0 / decaySamples);
            holdSamples = (float) (sr * holdMs / 1000.0);
            holdCounter = 0;
            stage = Attack;
        }

        void noteOff (float releaseMs, double sr)
        {
            const double relSamples = releaseMs * 0.001 * sr;
            segStart = level;
            segEnd   = 0.0f;
            segPhase = 0.0;
            segInc   = (releaseMs < 0.1f || relSamples < 1.0) ? 1.0e9 : (1.0 / relSamples);
            if (stage != Idle) stage = Release;
        }

        void kill() { stage = Idle; level = 0.0f; }

        float process()
        {
            switch (stage)
            {
                case Attack:
                    level += (kAttackTarget - level) * attackCoeff;
                    if (level >= 0.999f) { level = 1.0f; stage = Hold; holdCounter = 0; }
                    break;
                case Hold:
                    if ((float) ++holdCounter >= holdSamples)
                    {
                        segStart = level; segEnd = sustainLevel;
                        segPhase = 0.0;   segInc = decayInc;
                        stage = Decay;
                    }
                    break;
                case Decay:
                    segPhase += segInc;
                    if (segPhase >= 1.0) { level = sustainLevel; stage = Sustain; }
                    else level = segStart + (segEnd - segStart) * fallAmount ((float) segPhase, curveK);
                    break;
                case Sustain:
                    level = sustainLevel;
                    break;
                case Release:
                    segPhase += segInc;
                    if (segPhase >= 1.0) { level = 0.0f; stage = Idle; }
                    else level = segStart + (segEnd - segStart) * fallAmount ((float) segPhase, curveK);
                    break;
                case Idle:
                    break;
            }
            return level;
        }

        bool isActive() const { return stage != Idle; }
    };

    //==========================================================================
    //  TPT state-variable filter.  Coefficients are set once per control block
    //  (the tan() lives there, not in the sample loop).
    //  type: 0 LP, 1 HP, 2 BP, 3 Notch
    //==========================================================================
    struct TptSvf
    {
        float ic1 = 0.0f, ic2 = 0.0f;
        float a1 = 1.0f, a2 = 0.0f, a3 = 0.0f, k = 1.414f;
        int   type = 0;

        void reset() { ic1 = ic2 = 0.0f; }

        void set (float cutoffHz, float resonance01, int t, double sr)
        {
            type = t;
            const float g = (float) std::tan (dsp::kPi * dsp::clampv ((double) cutoffHz, 20.0, sr * 0.45) / sr);
            // resonance 0 is Butterworth (Q 0.707), the honest "no peak" setting
            const float q = 0.7071f + resonance01 * resonance01 * 14.0f;
            k  = 1.0f / q;
            a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + g * (g + k));
            a2 = g * a1;
            a3 = g * a2;
        }

        float process (float x)
        {
            const float v3 = x - ic2;
            const float v1 = a1 * ic1 + a2 * v3;
            const float v2 = ic2 + a2 * ic1 + a3 * v3;
            ic1 = 2.0f * v1 - ic1;
            ic2 = 2.0f * v2 - ic2;
            switch (type)
            {
                case 1:  return x - k * v1 - v2;
                case 2:  return v1 * k;
                case 3:  return x - k * v1;
                default: return v2;
            }
        }
    };

    //==========================================================================
    //  Sine LFO with pre-delay and a fade-in over the same time (control rate)
    //==========================================================================
    struct DelayedLfo
    {
        double phase = 0.0;
        double elapsed = 0.0;

        void reset (double startPhase = 0.0) { phase = startPhase; elapsed = 0.0; }

        /** dt seconds have passed; returns -1..1 scaled by the fade-in. */
        float tick (float rateHz, float delayS, double dt)
        {
            elapsed += dt;
            phase += rateHz * dt;
            phase -= std::floor (phase);
            float fade = 1.0f;
            if (delayS > 0.0f)
            {
                if (elapsed < delayS) fade = 0.0f;
                else fade = (float) std::min (1.0, (elapsed - delayS) / std::max (0.05, (double) delayS * 0.5));
            }
            return fade * (float) std::sin (dsp::kTwoPi * phase);
        }
    };

    //==========================================================================
    //  BODY: four resonances of a wooden box / soundboard.  Size moves them,
    //  material sets how sharp they ring, resonance how loud, mix how much of
    //  the box the "microphone" hears.
    //==========================================================================
    struct BodyFilter
    {
        dsp::Biquad peaks[4];
        dsp::OnePoleLP air;
        float mix = 0.0f;
        float lastSize = -1.0f, lastMat = -1.0f, lastReso = -1.0f;

        void reset() { for (auto& p : peaks) p.reset(); air.reset(); }

        void configure (float size, float material, float reso, float mixAmt, double sr)
        {
            mix = mixAmt;
            if (size == lastSize && material == lastMat && reso == lastReso) return;
            lastSize = size; lastMat = material; lastReso = reso;
            static const float base[4] = { 280.0f, 470.0f, 1050.0f, 2800.0f };
            static const float gains[4] = { 1.0f, 0.85f, 0.6f, 0.45f };
            const float scale = std::pow (2.0f, (0.5f - size) * 2.4f);
            const float q = dsp::lerp (1.6f, 9.0f, material);
            const float db = reso * 13.0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
                peaks[i].peak (base[i] * scale, q, db * gains[i], sr);
            air.setCutoff (dsp::lerp (16000.0f, 5500.0f, mixAmt), sr);
        }

        float process (float x)
        {
            if (mix <= 0.001f) return x;
            float y = x;
            for (auto& p : peaks) y = p.process (y);
            y = air.process (y);
            return x + (y - x) * mix;
        }
    };

    //==========================================================================
    //  CHARACTER: drive (symmetric saturation), warmth (asymmetric: even
    //  harmonics) and a tilt EQ around 800 Hz.
    //==========================================================================
    struct Character
    {
        dsp::OnePoleLP tiltLp;
        float drive = 0.0f, warmth = 0.0f, tilt = 0.0f;
        float pre = 1.0f, bias = 0.0f, tb = 0.0f, post = 1.0f, lowG = 1.0f, highG = 1.0f;

        void reset() { tiltLp.reset(); }

        void configure (float d, float w, float t, double sr)
        {
            drive = d; warmth = w; tilt = t;
            pre  = 1.0f + d * d * 14.0f;
            bias = w * 0.35f;
            tb   = std::tanh (bias);
            post = 1.0f / std::sqrt (pre);
            tiltLp.setCutoff (800.0, sr);
            lowG  = dsp::dbToGain (-t * 6.0f);
            highG = dsp::dbToGain ( t * 6.0f);
        }

        float process (float x)
        {
            if (drive > 0.001f || warmth > 0.001f)
                x = (std::tanh (x * pre + bias) - tb) * (drive > 0.001f ? post * 1.3f : 1.0f);
            if (std::abs (tilt) > 0.005f)
            {
                const float lo = tiltLp.process (x);
                x = lo * lowG + (x - lo) * highG;
            }
            return x;
        }
    };
}

// C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN natura\src\Theme.h
#pragma once

#include <JuceHeader.h>

// =============================================================================
// Theme
//
// All colors and standard dimensions used across the plugin GUI.
// Single source of truth — change one value, the whole plugin re-skins.
// =============================================================================
namespace Theme
{
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Window
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    constexpr int defaultWidth  = 1280;
    constexpr int defaultHeight = 720;     // 16:9
    constexpr int minWidth      = 960;
    constexpr int minHeight     = 540;     // 16:9
    constexpr int maxWidth      = 1920;
    constexpr int maxHeight     = 1080;    // 16:9

    constexpr double aspectRatio = 16.0 / 9.0;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Layout heights — scaled by Layout::scale() at runtime
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    namespace BaseSize
    {
        constexpr int headerHeight        = 38;
        constexpr int topNavHeight        = 32;
        constexpr int slotsColumnWidth    = 148;
        constexpr int subTabHeight        = 32;
        constexpr int modDrawerBarHeight  = 26;
        constexpr int modDrawerOpenHeight = 200;
        constexpr int bottomTabHeight     = 26;
        constexpr int bottomContentHeight = 84;
        constexpr int paddingS            = 4;
        constexpr int paddingM            = 8;
        constexpr int paddingL            = 12;
        constexpr int cornerRadius        = 6;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Colors — dark theme, flat, modern
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    namespace Color
    {
        // Backgrounds (darkest -> lightest)
        const juce::Colour bgPage        { 0xFF14141A };  // deepest, page bg
        const juce::Colour bgWorkspace   { 0xFF1B1B22 };  // main workspace area
        const juce::Colour bgStrip       { 0xFF20202A };  // header / strips
        const juce::Colour bgPanel       { 0xFF272731 };  // panels / cards
        const juce::Colour bgPanelHi     { 0xFF2F2F3B };  // hovered panel
        const juce::Colour bgInput       { 0xFF181820 };  // input fields / dropdowns

        // Borders
        const juce::Colour border        { 0xFF34343F };
        const juce::Colour borderStrong  { 0xFF4A4A57 };
        const juce::Colour borderSubtle  { 0xFF2A2A33 };

        // Text
        const juce::Colour textPrimary   { 0xFFE8E8EE };
        const juce::Colour textSecondary { 0xFFA0A0AC };
        const juce::Colour textTertiary  { 0xFF6A6A78 };
        const juce::Colour textDisabled  { 0xFF4A4A55 };

        // Accent (used for non-slot-specific highlights)
        const juce::Colour accent        { 0xFF4DD4C5 };  // bright teal-cyan
        const juce::Colour accentDim     { 0xFF2A8378 };

        // Status
        const juce::Colour success       { 0xFF6BCB77 };
        const juce::Colour warning       { 0xFFE0A323 };
        const juce::Colour danger        { 0xFFE65A5A };
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fonts
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    namespace Font
    {
        constexpr float sizeXS = 10.0f;
        constexpr float sizeS  = 11.0f;
        constexpr float sizeM  = 13.0f;
        constexpr float sizeL  = 15.0f;
        constexpr float sizeXL = 18.0f;

        inline juce::Font regular (float sizePt)
        {
            return juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (sizePt, juce::Font::plain));
        }

        inline juce::Font bold (float sizePt)
        {
            return juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (sizePt, juce::Font::bold));
        }

        // Logo font — Biergarten (Fanan Team brand). Falls back to bold sans
        // if the typeface isn't loaded. Wired up later via the L&F.
        inline juce::Font logo (float sizePt)
        {
            return juce::Font (juce::FontOptions (sizePt, juce::Font::bold));
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Layout — runtime scale factor based on current window vs default size
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    struct Layout
    {
        static float scale (int currentHeight) noexcept
        {
            return juce::jlimit (0.6f, 2.0f,
                                 (float) currentHeight / (float) defaultHeight);
        }

        static int s (int basePx, int currentHeight) noexcept
        {
            return juce::roundToInt ((float) basePx * scale (currentHeight));
        }
    };
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Natura additions: the window, and the Grex slider gold (GoldSlider,
    // VelCurveDisplay and the frame titles use these, exactly as in Grex).
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    namespace Natura
    {
        constexpr int width  = 1440;
        constexpr int height = 760;
    }

    namespace Gold
    {
        constexpr juce::uint32 kAccent       = 0xFFB87A36;   // Grex gold
        constexpr juce::uint32 kAccentLight  = 0xFFE5BB8D;
        constexpr juce::uint32 kAccentBright = 0xFFD09657;
        constexpr juce::uint32 kAccentGrad   = 0xFFA97032;
        constexpr juce::uint32 kAccentGradDk = 0xFF5D370F;
        constexpr juce::uint32 kAccentDark   = 0xFF54320E;
    }
}

# C:\workspace\SONIFY PLUGIN zax\CMakeLists.txt
#
# Zax - Sonify's GM drum synth (Fanan).  JUCE 9: VST3 + Standalone (+ AU on a Mac),
# CLAP through clap-juce-extensions when it is found.  Everything is built into
# the build folder only: nothing is copied anywhere else.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(Zax VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(APPLE)
    set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "10.15" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES "arm64;x86_64" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

# ---- JUCE -------------------------------------------------------------------
set(JUCE_DIR "C:/workspace/JUCE" CACHE PATH "JUCE 9 folder")
if(NOT EXISTS "${JUCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "JUCE not found at ${JUCE_DIR} - pass -DJUCE_DIR=<your JUCE folder>")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${JUCE_DIR}" JUCE)

# ---- CLAP (optional) --------------------------------------------------------
set(CLAP_EXT_DIR "" CACHE PATH "clap-juce-extensions folder (empty = search)")
if(NOT CLAP_EXT_DIR)
    foreach(candidate
            "C:/workspace/libs/CLAP_Extensions"
            "C:/workspace/libs/clap-juce-extensions"
            "C:/workspace/clap-juce-extensions-main"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../clap-juce-extensions")
        if(EXISTS "${candidate}/CMakeLists.txt")
            set(CLAP_EXT_DIR "${candidate}")
            break()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
if(CLAP_EXT_DIR AND EXISTS "${CLAP_EXT_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    add_subdirectory("${CLAP_EXT_DIR}" clap-juce-extensions EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    set(ZAX_WITH_CLAP ON)
    message(STATUS "Zax: CLAP from ${CLAP_EXT_DIR}")
else()
    set(ZAX_WITH_CLAP OFF)
    message(STATUS "Zax: clap-juce-extensions not found - building without CLAP")
endif()

# ---- The plugin -------------------------------------------------------------
set(ZAX_FORMATS VST3 Standalone)
if(APPLE)
    list(APPEND ZAX_FORMATS AU)
endif()

juce_add_plugin(Zax
    COMPANY_NAME                "Fanan"
    COMPANY_WEBSITE             "https://fanan.com"
    BUNDLE_ID                   "com.fanan.zax"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE    Fana
    PLUGIN_CODE                 Zaxd
    PRODUCT_NAME                "Zax"
    DESCRIPTION                 "GM drum synth"
    FORMATS                     ${ZAX_FORMATS}
    IS_SYNTH                    TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT            TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT           FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT              FALSE
    EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS FALSE
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD     FALSE
    VST3_CATEGORIES             Instrument Drum
    AU_MAIN_TYPE                kAudioUnitType_MusicDevice)

juce_generate_juce_header(Zax)

target_sources(Zax PRIVATE
    src/PluginProcessor.cpp
    src/PluginEditor.cpp)

target_include_directories(Zax PRIVATE src)

target_compile_definitions(Zax PUBLIC
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0)

if(WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(Zax PUBLIC JUCE_ASIO=1)   # the Standalone: JUCE's bundled ASIO
endif()

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(Zax PRIVATE /utf-8 /bigobj)
endif()

target_link_libraries(Zax
    PRIVATE
        juce::juce_audio_utils
        juce::juce_audio_processors
        juce::juce_dsp
    PUBLIC
        juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags)

if(ZAX_WITH_CLAP)
    clap_juce_extensions_plugin(TARGET Zax
        CLAP_ID       "com.fanan.zax"
        CLAP_FEATURES instrument drum-machine stereo)
endif()

//  ClapPrototypes.h — key 39
//
//  A clap is several short noise bursts a few milliseconds apart (many hands,
//  never quite together) followed by a filtered tail (the room).  The 808 and
//  909 claps are exactly that circuit; a real clap is the same shape with more
//  bursts and looser timing, so one topology covers both.
//==============================================================================

namespace clap
{

struct ClapPrototype
{
    const char* name;

    float bursts;        // number of bursts, 1..32 (float so it can morph; rounded per hit)
    float spacing;       // s between bursts
    float spread;        // 0..1 random variation of spacing and burst level
    float burstTau;      // s, decay of each burst

    float tailLevel;     // tail relative to a burst
    float tailTau;       // s

    float bpFreq;        // Hz, body band
    float bpQ;
    float hpMix;         // 0..1+ highpassed noise added for sizzle
    float hpFreq;        // Hz

    float drive;         // 0..1
    float level;         // linear

    // Level multiplier from one burst to the next (1 = even).  Below 1 the
    // train dies away - a vibraslap rattle, a guiro stroke.  Defaulted so
    // every clap in the table above keeps its exact sound.
    float burstDecay = 1.0f;
};

inline const std::array<ClapPrototype, 10>& prototypes()
{
    static const std::array<ClapPrototype, 10> bank =
    { {
        //  name                bursts spacing  spread  burstTau  tailLvl tailTau  bpFreq  bpQ   hpMix hpFreq  drive level
        { "808 Clap",           4.0f, 0.0095f, 0.15f, 0.0035f,  0.60f, 0.120f, 1050.0f, 1.2f, 0.15f, 3000.0f, 0.15f, 0.85f },
        { "909 Clap",           4.0f, 0.0080f, 0.20f, 0.0030f,  0.55f, 0.150f, 1400.0f, 1.1f, 0.35f, 4000.0f, 0.25f, 0.85f },
        { "Real Clap Small",    5.0f, 0.0110f, 0.55f, 0.0045f,  0.35f, 0.090f, 1600.0f, 0.8f, 0.40f, 3500.0f, 0.05f, 0.85f },
        { "Big Room Clap",      6.0f, 0.0130f, 0.45f, 0.0050f,  0.85f, 0.380f, 1300.0f, 0.9f, 0.30f, 3000.0f, 0.20f, 0.80f },
        { "Tight Clap",         3.0f, 0.0065f, 0.20f, 0.0025f,  0.30f, 0.060f, 1700.0f, 1.3f, 0.35f, 4500.0f, 0.20f, 0.85f },
        { "Trap Clap",          4.0f, 0.0070f, 0.25f, 0.0030f,  0.50f, 0.140f, 1250.0f, 1.0f, 0.45f, 5000.0f, 0.45f, 0.82f },
        { "House Clap",         4.0f, 0.0085f, 0.30f, 0.0035f,  0.65f, 0.200f, 1500.0f, 1.0f, 0.40f, 4000.0f, 0.30f, 0.82f },
        { "Snap Clap",          2.0f, 0.0050f, 0.15f, 0.0020f,  0.20f, 0.050f, 2200.0f, 1.6f, 0.50f, 6000.0f, 0.15f, 0.80f },
        { "Lo-fi Clap",         4.0f, 0.0100f, 0.35f, 0.0040f,  0.45f, 0.130f, 1100.0f, 0.9f, 0.10f, 2500.0f, 0.75f, 0.80f },
        { "Reverb Clap",        4.0f, 0.0090f, 0.30f, 0.0035f,  1.00f, 0.550f, 1350.0f, 0.9f, 0.35f, 3500.0f, 0.15f, 0.78f },
    } };

    return bank;
}

inline ClapPrototype morph (const ClapPrototype& a, const ClapPrototype& b, float t)
{
    using drum::lerp;
    using drum::logLerp;
    t = std::clamp (t, 0.0f, 1.0f);

    ClapPrototype r = a;
    r.bursts    = lerp    (a.bursts,    b.bursts,    t);
    r.spacing   = logLerp (a.spacing,   b.spacing,   t);
    r.spread    = lerp    (a.spread,    b.spread,    t);
    r.burstTau  = logLerp (a.burstTau,  b.burstTau,  t);
    r.tailLevel = lerp    (a.tailLevel, b.tailLevel, t);
    r.tailTau   = logLerp (a.tailTau,   b.tailTau,   t);
    r.bpFreq    = logLerp (a.bpFreq,    b.bpFreq,    t);
    r.bpQ       = logLerp (a.bpQ,       b.bpQ,       t);
    r.hpMix     = lerp    (a.hpMix,     b.hpMix,     t);
    r.hpFreq    = logLerp (a.hpFreq,    b.hpFreq,    t);
    r.drive     = lerp    (a.drive,     b.drive,     t);
    r.level     = lerp    (a.level,     b.level,     t);
    r.burstDecay = lerp   (a.burstDecay, b.burstDecay, t);
    return r;
}

#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>
#include "DrumDsp.h"
#include "ClapPrototypes.h"

//==============================================================================
//  ClapVoice.h
//
//  Burst train + tail, both on one noise source filtered through a bandpass
//  (the body) plus a highpass (the sizzle).  Burst start times and levels are
//  rolled per hit, so every clap is a slightly different group of hands.
//
//  Macro meanings on this voice:
//      TUNE   filter pitch               DECAY  tail + burst length
//      DAMP   tail amount (the room)     SNAP   burst sharpness
//      COLOR  brightness                 DRIVE  saturation
//      HUMAN  timing spread + per-hit level/decay
//      VEL    velocity -> level, brightness
//==============================================================================

namespace clap
{

class ClapVoice
{
public:
    static constexpr int   kMaxBursts = 32;   // guiro and vibraslap need long trains
    static constexpr float kMakeup    = 1.0f;

    void prepare (double sampleRate)
    {
        sr = (float) std::max (8000.0, sampleRate);
        killStep = 1.0f / (0.003f * sr);
        reset();
    }

    void setSeed (uint32_t s) noexcept   { rng.seed (s); }

    void reset()
    {
        active = false;
        killing = false;
        killGain = 1.0f;
        bpSvf.reset();
        hpSvf.reset();
    }

    bool isActive() const noexcept   { return active; }
    void beginKill() noexcept        { if (active) killing = true; }

    //==========================================================================
    void trigger (const ClapPrototype& p, const drum::Macros& m, int velocity)
    {
        const auto hum = drum::rollHumanize (rng, m.humanize);
        const auto vr  = drum::velocityResponse (velocity, m.velSens);

        const float tuneMul  = std::pow (2.0f, (m.tuneSemis + hum.tuneCents * 0.01f) / 12.0f);
        const float decayMul = std::pow (4.0f, drum::bipolarAmount (m.decay)) * hum.decayMul;
        const float dampAmt  = drum::bipolarAmount (m.damp);    // + = less room
        const float snapAmt  = drum::bipolarAmount (m.snap);    // + = sharper bursts
        const float colorAmt = drum::bipolarAmount (m.color);   // + = brighter

        // ---- Burst schedule -----------------------------------------------------
        numBursts = std::clamp ((int) std::lround (p.bursts), 1, kMaxBursts);
        const float spread = std::clamp (p.spread + 0.3f * std::clamp (m.humanize, 0.0f, 1.0f), 0.0f, 1.0f);

        float t = 0.0f;
        for (int k = 0; k < numBursts; ++k)
        {
            if (k > 0)
                t += p.spacing * (1.0f + spread * 0.35f * rng.bipolar());
            burstStart[k] = (int) (t * sr);
            burstAmp  [k] = ((k == 0) ? 1.0f : 1.0f - spread * 0.35f * rng.unipolar())
                          * std::pow (std::clamp (p.burstDecay, 0.05f, 1.0f), (float) k);
        }
        nextBurst = 0;
        burstEnv  = 0.0f;

        const float burstTau = std::clamp (p.burstTau * decayMul * std::pow (2.0f, -snapAmt * 0.8f),
                                           0.0008f, 0.02f);
        burstCoef = drum::coefForTau (burstTau, sr);

        // ---- Tail -----------------------------------------------------------------
        tailStart = burstStart[numBursts - 1];
        tailAmp   = p.tailLevel * std::pow (2.0f, -dampAmt * 1.5f);
        const float tailTau = std::clamp (p.tailTau * decayMul, 0.01f, 3.0f);
        tailCoef  = drum::coefForTau (tailTau, sr);
        tailEnv   = 0.0f;
        tailOn    = false;

        // ---- Filters --------------------------------------------------------------
        const float colorMul = std::pow (2.0f, colorAmt * 0.5f);
        bpSvf.reset();
        hpSvf.reset();
        bpSvf.set (p.bpFreq * tuneMul * colorMul * vr.bright, std::max (0.3f, p.bpQ), sr);
        hpSvf.set (p.hpFreq * tuneMul * colorMul, 0.707f, sr);
        hpMix = std::clamp (p.hpMix * (1.0f + colorAmt * 0.5f), 0.0f, 1.5f);

        // ---- Drive + output -------------------------------------------------------
        const float d = std::clamp (p.drive + m.drive, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        drivePre    = 1.0f + 9.0f * d;
        driveMakeup = 1.0f / std::sqrt (drivePre);
        outGain     = p.level * vr.level * drum::dbToGain (hum.levelDb) * kMakeup;

        clock = 0;
        samplesLeft = tailStart + drum::lifetimeSamples (std::max (tailTau, burstTau), sr, 4.0f);
        killGain = 1.0f;
        killing  = false;
        active   = true;
    }

    //==========================================================================
    void render (float* left, float* right, int numSamples)
    {
        if (! active)
            return;

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            if (nextBurst < numBursts && clock >= burstStart[nextBurst])
            {
                burstEnv = burstAmp[nextBurst];
                ++nextBurst;
            }
            burstEnv *= burstCoef;

            if (! tailOn && clock >= tailStart)
            {
                tailOn  = true;
                tailEnv = tailAmp;
            }
            if (tailOn)
                tailEnv *= tailCoef;

            const float n = rng.bipolar();
            float lp, bp, hp, lp2, bp2, hp2;
            bpSvf.process (n, lp, bp, hp);
            hpSvf.process (n, lp2, bp2, hp2);
            const float filtered = bp + hpMix * hp2;

            float s = filtered * (burstEnv + tailEnv);
            s = std::tanh (s * drivePre) * driveMakeup;
            s *= outGain;

            if (killing)
            {
                killGain -= killStep;
                if (killGain <= 0.0f) { active = false; return; }
            }
            s *= killGain;

            left [i] += s;
            right[i] += s;

            ++clock;
            if (--samplesLeft <= 0) { active = false; return; }
        }
    }

private:
    drum::Rng rng;
    float sr = 48000.0f;

    int   numBursts = 1, nextBurst = 0;
    int   burstStart[kMaxBursts] {};
    float burstAmp  [kMaxBursts] {};
    float burstEnv = 0.0f, burstCoef = 0.0f;

    int   tailStart = 0;
    bool  tailOn = false;
    float tailAmp = 0.0f, tailEnv = 0.0f, tailCoef = 0.0f;

    drum::Svf bpSvf, hpSvf;
    float hpMix = 0.0f;

    float drivePre = 1.0f, driveMakeup = 1.0f, outGain = 1.0f;

    int   clock = 0;
    bool  active = false;
    int   samplesLeft = 0;
    bool  killing = false;
    float killGain = 1.0f, killStep = 0.0f;
};

} // namespace clap

#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include "DrumDsp.h"

//==============================================================================
//  CymbalPrototypes.h — key 49 (crash) and key 51 (ride)
//
//  One topology for both:
//      Wash  — eight square oscillators at inharmonic ratios + noise, through a
//              bandpass and a highpass, with an attack swell and a long decay
//      Ping  — three high partials with their own decay: the ride's stick
//              definition, and at low partial numbers, its bell
//      Stick — a short bandpassed noise tick
//  Crashes run with the ping at zero; rides use all three layers.
//==============================================================================

namespace cymbal
{

static constexpr int kNumPartials = 8;
static constexpr int kNumPings    = 3;

struct CymbalPrototype
{
    const char* name;

    float baseFreq;                   // Hz of partial 1
    float ratio[kNumPartials];        // inharmonic ratios
    float metalLevel;                 // 0..1
    float noiseLevel;                 // 0..1
    float bpFreq, bpQ;                // Hz
    float hpFreq;                     // Hz
    float washTau;                    // s
    float attack;                     // s (swell)

    float pingLevel;                  // 0 for crashes
    float pingFreq[kNumPings];        // Hz
    float pingTau;                    // s

    float clickLevel;
    float clickFreq;                  // Hz
    float clickTau;                   // s

    float drive;                      // 0..1
    float level;                      // linear

    // ---- Bell realism.  Defaulted, so every table entry above gets them. ----
    float pingDetune = 0.0035f;       // each ping partial is a detuned PAIR: they beat, like metal
    float pingSpread = 0.20f;         // higher ping partials decay faster by this much per step
};

//  Partial sets — measured-cymbal-like inharmonic spreads
//==============================================================================

//==============================================================================
inline CymbalPrototype morph (const CymbalPrototype& a, const CymbalPrototype& b, float t)
{
    using drum::lerp;
    using drum::logLerp;
    t = std::clamp (t, 0.0f, 1.0f);

    CymbalPrototype r = a;
    r.baseFreq = logLerp (a.baseFreq, b.baseFreq, t);
    for (int k = 0; k < kNumPartials; ++k)
        r.ratio[k] = logLerp (a.ratio[k], b.ratio[k], t);
    r.metalLevel = lerp    (a.metalLevel, b.metalLevel, t);
    r.noiseLevel = lerp    (a.noiseLevel, b.noiseLevel, t);
    r.bpFreq     = logLerp (a.bpFreq,     b.bpFreq,     t);
    r.bpQ        = logLerp (a.bpQ,        b.bpQ,        t);
    r.hpFreq     = logLerp (a.hpFreq,     b.hpFreq,     t);
    r.washTau    = logLerp (a.washTau,    b.washTau,    t);
    r.attack     = logLerp (a.attack,     b.attack,     t);
    r.pingLevel  = lerp    (a.pingLevel,  b.pingLevel,  t);
    for (int k = 0; k < kNumPings; ++k)
        r.pingFreq[k] = logLerp (a.pingFreq[k], b.pingFreq[k], t);
    r.pingTau    = logLerp (a.pingTau,    b.pingTau,    t);
    r.clickLevel = lerp    (a.clickLevel, b.clickLevel, t);
    r.clickFreq  = logLerp (a.clickFreq,  b.clickFreq,  t);
    r.clickTau   = logLerp (a.clickTau,   b.clickTau,   t);
    r.drive      = lerp    (a.drive,      b.drive,      t);
    r.level      = lerp    (a.level,      b.level,      t);
    r.pingDetune = lerp    (a.pingDetune, b.pingDetune, t);
    r.pingSpread = lerp    (a.pingSpread, b.pingSpread, t);
    return r;
}

#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>
#include "DrumDsp.h"
#include "CymbalPrototypes.h"

//==============================================================================
//  CymbalVoice.h — crash (49) and ride (51)
//
//      Wash  — 8 band-limited squares + noise -> bandpass -> highpass,
//              attack swell x long exponential decay
//      Ping  — 3 decaying sines (ride definition / bell)
//      Stick — bandpassed noise tick
//
//  Macro meanings on this voice:
//      TUNE   metal + ping pitch         DECAY  wash and ping length
//      DAMP   ping <-> wash balance (+ = drier: less wash, more ping)
//      SNAP   stick tick                 COLOR  wash brightness
//      DRIVE  saturation                 HUMAN  per-hit tune/decay/tick/level
//      VEL    velocity -> level, brightness, tick
//==============================================================================

namespace cymbal
{

class CymbalVoice
{
public:
    static constexpr float kMakeup = 1.0f;

    void prepare (double sampleRate)
    {
        sr = (float) std::max (8000.0, sampleRate);
        twoPiOverSr = 6.28318530718f / sr;
        killStep = 1.0f / (0.004f * sr);
        reset();
    }

    void setSeed (uint32_t s) noexcept   { rng.seed (s); }

    void reset()
    {
        active = false;
        killing = false;
        killGain = 1.0f;
        bpSvf.reset();
        hpSvf.reset();
        clickSvf.reset();
    }

    bool isActive() const noexcept   { return active; }
    void beginKill() noexcept        { if (active) killing = true; }

    //==========================================================================
    void trigger (const CymbalPrototype& p, const drum::Macros& m, int velocity)
    {
        const auto hum = drum::rollHumanize (rng, m.humanize);
        const auto vr  = drum::velocityResponse (velocity, m.velSens);

        const float tuneMul  = std::pow (2.0f, (m.tuneSemis + hum.tuneCents * 0.01f) / 12.0f);
        const float decayMul = std::pow (4.0f, drum::bipolarAmount (m.decay)) * hum.decayMul;
        const float dampAmt  = drum::bipolarAmount (m.damp);
        const float colorAmt = drum::bipolarAmount (m.color);
        const float snapMul  = std::clamp (m.snap, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 2.0f;

        // ---- Wash -------------------------------------------------------------------
        for (int k = 0; k < kNumPartials; ++k)
        {
            osc[k].setFrequency (p.baseFreq * p.ratio[k] * tuneMul, sr);
            osc[k].reset (rng.unipolar());
        }

        const float drier = std::max (0.0f, dampAmt);
        const float wetter = std::max (0.0f, -dampAmt);
        washAmp  = (1.0f - 0.7f * drier) * (1.0f + 0.3f * wetter);
        metalAmp = p.metalLevel;
        noiseAmp = p.noiseLevel;

        bpSvf.reset();
        hpSvf.reset();
        bpSvf.set (p.bpFreq * std::pow (2.0f, colorAmt) * vr.bright, std::max (0.3f, p.bpQ), sr);
        hpSvf.set (p.hpFreq * std::pow (2.0f, colorAmt * 0.7f), 0.707f, sr);

        const float washTau = std::clamp (p.washTau * decayMul * std::pow (2.0f, -drier * 0.5f),
                                          0.05f, 8.0f);
        washCoef = drum::coefForTau (washTau, sr);
        washEnv  = 1.0f;
        att      = 0.0f;
        attCoef  = drum::coefForTau (std::max (p.attack, 0.0002f), sr);

        // ---- Ping -------------------------------------------------------------------
        const float pingBoost = (1.0f + 0.8f * drier) * (1.0f - 0.5f * wetter);
        static constexpr float kPingWeights[kNumPings] = { 1.0f, 0.6f, 0.4f };
        // Each ping is a detuned PAIR (they beat, as struck metal does), with a
        // fresh random phase and detune every hit, and a decay that shortens
        // for the higher pings.
        const float detune = std::clamp (p.pingDetune, 0.0f, 0.03f);
        const float spread = std::clamp (p.pingSpread, 0.0f, 0.3f);
        const float pingTau = std::clamp (p.pingTau * decayMul, 0.02f, 4.0f);
        for (int k = 0; k < kNumPings; ++k)
            for (int side = 0; side < 2; ++side)
            {
                const int   j  = k * 2 + side;
                const float dt = (side == 0 ? -detune : detune) * (0.7f + 0.6f * rng.unipolar());
                pingFreq [j] = std::clamp (p.pingFreq[k] * tuneMul * (1.0f + dt), 100.0f, sr * 0.45f);
                pingAmp  [j] = p.pingLevel * pingBoost * kPingWeights[k] * 0.5f;
                pingPhase[j] = rng.unipolar() * 6.28318530718f;
                pingCoef [j] = drum::coefForTau (std::max (0.02f, pingTau * (1.0f - spread * (float) k)), sr);
                pingEnv  [j] = 1.0f;
            }

        // ---- Stick ------------------------------------------------------------------
        clickAmp  = p.clickLevel * snapMul * vr.attack * hum.attackMul;
        clickCoef = drum::coefForTau (std::clamp (p.clickTau, 0.0005f, 0.02f), sr);
        clickEnv  = 1.0f;
        clickSvf.set (p.clickFreq * std::pow (2.0f, colorAmt * 0.5f), 1.0f, sr);

        // ---- Drive + output ---------------------------------------------------------
        const float d = std::clamp (p.drive + m.drive, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        drivePre    = 1.0f + 9.0f * d;
        driveMakeup = 1.0f / std::sqrt (drivePre);
        outGain     = p.level * vr.level * drum::dbToGain (hum.levelDb) * kMakeup;

        samplesLeft = drum::lifetimeSamples (std::max (washTau, pingTau), sr, 12.0f);
        killGain = 1.0f;
        killing  = false;
        active   = true;
    }

    //==========================================================================
    void render (float* left, float* right, int numSamples)
    {
        if (! active)
            return;

        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i)
        {
            // Wash
            float metal = 0.0f;
            for (int k = 0; k < kNumPartials; ++k)
                metal += osc[k].next();
            metal *= (1.0f / (float) kNumPartials);

            const float src = metal * metalAmp + rng.bipolar() * noiseAmp;
            float lp, bp, hp, lp2, bp2, hp2;
            bpSvf.process (src, lp, bp, hp);
            hpSvf.process (bp, lp2, bp2, hp2);

            washEnv *= washCoef;
            att = 1.0f + (att - 1.0f) * attCoef;
            const float wash = hp2 * washEnv * att * washAmp;

            // Ping: detuned pairs, each with its own decay
            float ping = 0.0f;
            for (int j = 0; j < kPingPartials; ++j)
            {
                pingPhase[j] += twoPiOverSr * pingFreq[j];
                if (pingPhase[j] > 6.28318530718f) pingPhase[j] -= 6.28318530718f;
                pingEnv[j] *= pingCoef[j];
                ping += std::sin (pingPhase[j]) * pingAmp[j] * pingEnv[j];
            }

            // Stick
            clickEnv *= clickCoef;
            clickSvf.process (rng.bipolar(), lp, bp, hp);
            const float click = bp * clickEnv * clickAmp;

            float s = std::tanh ((wash + ping + click) * drivePre) * driveMakeup;
            s *= outGain;

            if (killing)
            {
                killGain -= killStep;
                if (killGain <= 0.0f) { active = false; return; }
            }
            s *= killGain;

            left [i] += s;
            right[i] += s;

            if (--samplesLeft <= 0) { active = false; return; }
        }
    }

private:
    drum::Rng rng;
    float sr = 48000.0f, twoPiOverSr = 0.0f;

    drum::BlepSquare osc[kNumPartials];
    float metalAmp = 0.0f, noiseAmp = 0.0f, washAmp = 1.0f;
    drum::Svf bpSvf, hpSvf;
    float washEnv = 0.0f, washCoef = 0.0f, att = 0.0f, attCoef = 0.0f;

    static constexpr int kPingPartials = kNumPings * 2;
    float pingFreq [kPingPartials] {};
    float pingAmp  [kPingPartials] {};
    float pingPhase[kPingPartials] {};
    float pingEnv  [kPingPartials] {};
    float pingCoef [kPingPartials] {};

    float clickAmp = 0.0f, clickEnv = 0.0f, clickCoef = 0.0f;
    drum::Svf clickSvf;

    float drivePre = 1.0f, driveMakeup = 1.0f, outGain = 1.0f;

    bool  active = false;
    int   samplesLeft = 0;
    bool  killing = false;
    float killGain = 1.0f, killStep = 0.0f;
};

} // namespace cymbal

#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <algorithm>

//==============================================================================
//  DrumDsp.h
//
//  Shared building blocks for the kit's voices (snare, clap, hats, cymbals).
//
//  DELIBERATELY JUCE-FREE.  Every voice built on this header is plain C++, so
//  the same code can run inside Grex to render electronic kits straight into
//  kit samples — one copy of the DSP, two products.  Keep it that way: no
//  juce:: types in here or in any *Voice.h / *Prototypes.h.
//
//  The kick voice (KickVoice.h) predates this header and keeps its own copies
//  of the SVF and macro struct, unchanged from the approved audition.  The
//  processor converts drum::Macros to kick::Macros for the kick and tom slots.
//==============================================================================

namespace drum
{

//==============================================================================
//  The per-page control surface, read from the host parameters at note-on.
//  Same eight macros on every page; each voice interprets them for its drum.
//==============================================================================
struct Macros
{
    float tuneSemis  = 0.0f;   // -12 .. +12
    float decay      = 0.5f;   // 0..1, 0.5 = neutral
    float damp       = 0.5f;   // 0..1, 0.5 = neutral (meaning differs per voice)
    float snap       = 0.5f;   // 0..1, 0.5 = neutral (1x attack)
    float color      = 0.5f;   // 0..1, 0.5 = neutral
    float drive      = 0.15f;  // 0..1, ADDS to the prototype drive
    float humanize   = 0.25f;  // 0..1
    float velSens    = 0.6f;   // 0..1
};

//==============================================================================
inline float lerp (float a, float b, float t) noexcept   { return a + (b - a) * t; }

// Log-domain interpolation for frequencies and time constants.
inline float logLerp (float a, float b, float t) noexcept
{
    const float lo = 1.0e-5f;
    a = std::max (a, lo);
    b = std::max (b, lo);
    return a * std::pow (b / a, t);
}

// One-pole decay coefficient for an exponential with time constant tau.
inline float coefForTau (float tauSeconds, float sampleRate) noexcept
{
    return std::exp (-1.0f / (std::max (tauSeconds, 1.0e-5f) * sampleRate));
}

inline float dbToGain (float db) noexcept   { return std::pow (10.0f, db / 20.0f); }

// Macro knob 0..1 centred at 0.5 -> -1..+1
inline float bipolarAmount (float knob01) noexcept
{
    return (std::clamp (knob01, 0.0f, 1.0f) - 0.5f) * 2.0f;
}

//==============================================================================
//  xorshift32 — allocation-free and real-time safe.  Each voice owns one and
//  the processor seeds them differently, so no two voices share a noise stream.
//==============================================================================
class Rng
{
public:
    void seed (uint32_t s) noexcept   { state = (s != 0u) ? s : 0x9E3779B9u; }

    inline float bipolar() noexcept                      // -1..1
    {
        state ^= state << 13;
        state ^= state >> 17;
        state ^= state << 5;
        return (float) (int32_t) state * 4.6566129e-10f;
    }

    inline float unipolar() noexcept                     // 0..1
    {
        return 0.5f * (bipolar() + 1.0f);
    }

private:
    uint32_t state = 0x9E3779B9u;
};

//==============================================================================
//  TPT state-variable filter (Zavalishin) — same maths as the kick's.
//==============================================================================
struct Svf
{
    void set (float fc, float q, float sampleRate) noexcept
    {
        fc = std::clamp (fc, 20.0f, sampleRate * 0.45f);
        const float g = std::tan (3.14159265f * fc / sampleRate);
        k  = 1.0f / std::max (0.05f, q);
        a1 = 1.0f / (1.0f + g * (g + k));
        a2 = g * a1;
        a3 = g * a2;
    }

    void reset() noexcept   { ic1 = ic2 = 0.0f; }

    inline void process (float v0, float& lp, float& bp, float& hp) noexcept
    {
        const float v3 = v0 - ic2;
        const float v1 = a1 * ic1 + a2 * v3;
        const float v2 = ic2 + a2 * ic1 + a3 * v3;
        ic1 = 2.0f * v1 - ic1;
        ic2 = 2.0f * v2 - ic2;
        lp = v2;
        bp = v1;
        hp = v0 - k * v1 - v2;
    }

    float k = 1.0f, a1 = 0.0f, a2 = 0.0f, a3 = 0.0f;
    float ic1 = 0.0f, ic2 = 0.0f;
};

//==============================================================================
//  PolyBLEP square — the metal voices stack several of these.  A naive square
//  folds its upper harmonics back below Nyquist, and the hat/cymbal filters sit
//  exactly where that fold-back lands, so the band-limiting is audible there.
//==============================================================================
inline float polyBlep (float t, float dt) noexcept
{
    if (t < dt)
    {
        t /= dt;
        return t + t - t * t - 1.0f;
    }
    if (t > 1.0f - dt)
    {
        t = (t - 1.0f) / dt;
        return t * t + t + t + 1.0f;
    }
    return 0.0f;
}

struct BlepSquare
{
    void reset (float startPhase01) noexcept
    {
        phase = startPhase01 - std::floor (startPhase01);
    }

    void setFrequency (float hz, float sampleRate) noexcept
    {
        inc = std::clamp (hz / sampleRate, 0.0f, 0.45f);
    }

    inline float next() noexcept
    {
        float v = (phase < 0.5f) ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
        v += polyBlep (phase, inc);
        float shifted = phase + 0.5f;
        if (shifted >= 1.0f) shifted -= 1.0f;
        v -= polyBlep (shifted, inc);

        phase += inc;
        if (phase >= 1.0f) phase -= 1.0f;
        return v;
    }

    float phase = 0.0f, inc = 0.0f;
};

//==============================================================================
//  Velocity response shared by every new voice — the same curves the kick
//  uses, plus a brightness factor for the noise-based drums.
//==============================================================================
struct VelocityResponse
{
    float level  = 1.0f;
    float attack = 1.0f;   // click / stick emphasis
    float pitch  = 1.0f;   // pitch-envelope depth
    float bright = 1.0f;   // filter frequency multiplier
};

inline VelocityResponse velocityResponse (int velocity, float velSens) noexcept
{
    const float vel  = std::clamp ((float) velocity, 1.0f, 127.0f) / 127.0f;
    const float sens = std::clamp (velSens, 0.0f, 1.0f);

    VelocityResponse r;
    r.level  = lerp (1.0f, std::pow (vel, 1.2f), sens);
    r.attack = lerp (1.0f, 0.25f + vel * 1.5f, sens);
    r.pitch  = lerp (1.0f, 0.55f + vel * 0.8f, sens);
    r.bright = lerp (1.0f, 0.60f + vel * 0.8f, sens);
    return r;
}

//==============================================================================
//  Per-hit humanize: the four randoms every voice latches at note-on.
//==============================================================================
struct Humanize
{
    float tuneCents = 0.0f;
    float decayMul  = 1.0f;
    float attackMul = 1.0f;
    float levelDb   = 0.0f;
};

inline Humanize rollHumanize (Rng& rng, float amount01) noexcept
{
    const float h = std::clamp (amount01, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    Humanize r;
    r.tuneCents = rng.bipolar() * 25.0f * h;
    r.decayMul  = 1.0f + rng.bipolar() * 0.10f * h;
    r.attackMul = 1.0f + rng.bipolar() * 0.25f * h;
    r.levelDb   = rng.bipolar() * 1.2f  * h;
    return r;
}

// Samples a voice should live for, given its longest decay time constant.
// 7 tau is ~ -60 dB; the tail beyond that is inaudible.
inline int lifetimeSamples (float longestTau, float sampleRate, float maxSeconds) noexcept
{
    const float s = sampleRate * (longestTau * 7.0f + 0.03f);
    return (int) std::min (s, sampleRate * maxSeconds);
}

} // namespace drum

Size: 11.78 KB
